data-title="What could you learn from the very best minds in design?<br>
<br>
The Conversations in Design talks programme at Focus/26 on Design brings together A-list designers, leading editors and some of the industry’s most respected creative minds to share their knowledge, experience and expertise.<br>
<br>
It’s a rare opportunity to listen to the people behind some of the world’s most exciting interiors, projects and collections, with unparalleled access to the thinking, ideas and experiences that have shaped their work.<br>
<br>
Come ready to listen, learn and take notes. Leave with fresh perspectives, invaluable insights and ideas to bring back to your own projects.<br>
<br>
Tickets are £10. Book your place via the link in bio 🔗<br>
<br>
More talks to be released soon!<br>
<br>
Speakers and moderators: Linda Morey-Burrows, principal director and founder of @moreysmith and @philipbershad, President and co-CEO of @phillipjeffriesltd, Martin Waller, founder of @andrewmartin_int, @mrbspriggs, editor in chief @elledecorationuk, @lorenzocastillofe, @interiorseditor editor of @houseandgardenuk, @vanessamacdonaldmwltd, Natasha Greig, partner and creative director of @grenneygreig, @annahainesdesigns, @ginnyemily acting editor of @homesandgardensofficial, @indiahicksstyle, @willowkemp design director @kitkempdesignthread, @robertangelldesignint, @carolewannett interiors editor of @countryandtownhouse, @michaelsmithinc, @hattabyng of @createacademyofficial, @geosaumarezsmith partner at @adamarchitecture, Ben Holland co-founder of @hollandgreeninteriors, @vsp_interiors and @giles.kime executive and interiors editor of @countrylifemagazine."

data-title="Celebrating our much loved four-pawed furry friends on International Dog Day, and every day after 🐾🤎<br>
<br>
The newest face to our Design Centre gang, Pip, is the star behind our AW26 Creative Campaign and is perched on the fabulous new ‘Douglas’ dog bed by Kingcome. <br>
<br>
Product credits: <br>
1. ‘Crackle’ rug, lichen, @timpagecarpets <br>
2. ‘Douglas’ dog bed, @kingcomesofas, upholstered in ‘Glen Check’ fabric (F4975-04), olive, @colefaxandfowler<br>
<br>
Park Life: An @andrewmartin_int collaboration with interior designer @sophiepatersoninteriors, is a charming celebration of Britain’s love of dogs.<br>
<br>
Each dog on  has been hand-drawn and painted by Sophie, inspired by the pets of friends, family, and followers who shared their beloved breeds. From elegant pointers to playful dachshunds, the illustrations capture the distinct personality of each companion and are depicted on the collection of fabrics, cushions and wallpaper.   Find the collection in the Andrew Martin Showroom. Ground Floor, North Dome.<br>
<br>
We’d be surprised if you’ve yet to meet miss Mabel in the Design Centre. Making her model debut here in the @phillipjeffriesltd Morning Room by @saracosgrovestudio, she can concur that the custom dog bed, lined with ‘Cameron’ wallcovering by Phillip Jeffries was a dogs dream chill spot. <br>
<br>
Phillip Jeffries showroom is located on the Second Floor, North Dome.<br>
<br>
Bring a little canine charm into your interiors 🐾 ‘Mountain Dogs’ by MindTheGap is full of character, a charming way to give furry friends a place in the design scheme, without compromising on style.<br>
<br>
Discover in the @mindtgap Showroom, Second Floor, Centre Dome.<br>
<br>
Meet Suki, @chaseerwinfabrics’s CEO’s four-legged right hand 🐾 A very important member of the Chase Erwin team, with plenty of personality to match.<br>
<br>
Naturally, she has her own Instagram too: @sukidaboss.<br>
<br>
The Michael S. Smith x Zoffany collaboration has been a design highlight of the summer, and we are thrilled to be welcoming Zoffany x Michael S. Smith & Sharland England to the Design Avenue during Focus/26 on Design… and perhaps have a guest appearance from this fabulous pooch?<br>
<br>
@zoffanyfw @michaelsmithinc @sharland_england<br>
<br>
A classic combination with a polished fini"

data-title="What could you learn from the very best minds in design?<br>
<br>
The Conversations in Design talks programme at Focus/26 on Design brings together A-list designers, leading editors and some of the industry’s most respected creative minds to share their knowledge, experience and expertise.<br>
<br>
It’s a rare opportunity to listen to the people behind some of the world’s most exciting interiors, projects and collections, with unparalleled access to the thinking, ideas and experiences that have shaped their work.<br>
<br>
Come ready to listen, learn and take notes. Leave with fresh perspectives, invaluable insights and ideas to bring back to your own projects.<br>
<br>
Tickets are £10. Book your place via the link in bio 🔗<br>
<br>
More talks to be released soon!<br>
<br>
Speakers and moderators: Linda Morey-Burrows, principal director and founder of @moreysmith and @philipbershad, President and co-CEO of @phillipjeffriesltd, Martin Waller, founder of @andrewmartin_int, @mrbspriggs, editor in chief @elledecorationuk, @lorenzocastillofe, @interiorseditor editor of @houseandgardenuk, @vanessamacdonaldmwltd, Natasha Greig, partner and creative director of @grenneygreig, @annahainesdesigns, @ginnyemily acting editor of @homesandgardensofficial, @indiahicksstyle, @willowkemp design director @kitkempdesignthread, @robertangelldesignint, @carolewannett interiors editor of @countryandtownhouse, @michaelsmithinc, @hattabyng of @createacademyofficial, @geosaumarezsmith partner at @adamarchitecture, Ben Holland co-founder of @hollandgreeninteriors, @vsp_interiors and @giles.kime executive and interiors editor of @countrylifemagazine."

data-title="Celebrating our much loved four-pawed furry friends on International Dog Day, and every day after 🐾🤎<br>
<br>
The newest face to our Design Centre gang, Pip, is the star behind our AW26 Creative Campaign and is perched on the fabulous new ‘Douglas’ dog bed by Kingcome. <br>
<br>
Product credits: <br>
1. ‘Crackle’ rug, lichen, @timpagecarpets <br>
2. ‘Douglas’ dog bed, @kingcomesofas, upholstered in ‘Glen Check’ fabric (F4975-04), olive, @colefaxandfowler<br>
<br>
Park Life: An @andrewmartin_int collaboration with interior designer @sophiepatersoninteriors, is a charming celebration of Britain’s love of dogs.<br>
<br>
Each dog on  has been hand-drawn and painted by Sophie, inspired by the pets of friends, family, and followers who shared their beloved breeds. From elegant pointers to playful dachshunds, the illustrations capture the distinct personality of each companion and are depicted on the collection of fabrics, cushions and wallpaper.   Find the collection in the Andrew Martin Showroom. Ground Floor, North Dome.<br>
<br>
We’d be surprised if you’ve yet to meet miss Mabel in the Design Centre. Making her model debut here in the @phillipjeffriesltd Morning Room by @saracosgrovestudio, she can concur that the custom dog bed, lined with ‘Cameron’ wallcovering by Phillip Jeffries was a dogs dream chill spot. <br>
<br>
Phillip Jeffries showroom is located on the Second Floor, North Dome.<br>
<br>
Bring a little canine charm into your interiors 🐾 ‘Mountain Dogs’ by MindTheGap is full of character, a charming way to give furry friends a place in the design scheme, without compromising on style.<br>
<br>
Discover in the @mindtgap Showroom, Second Floor, Centre Dome.<br>
<br>
Meet Suki, @chaseerwinfabrics’s CEO’s four-legged right hand 🐾 A very important member of the Chase Erwin team, with plenty of personality to match.<br>
<br>
Naturally, she has her own Instagram too: @sukidaboss.<br>
<br>
The Michael S. Smith x Zoffany collaboration has been a design highlight of the summer, and we are thrilled to be welcoming Zoffany x Michael S. Smith & Sharland England to the Design Avenue during Focus/26 on Design… and perhaps have a guest appearance from this fabulous pooch?<br>
<br>
@zoffanyfw @michaelsmithinc @sharland_england<br>
<br>
A classic combination with a polished fini"

  document.querySelectorAll('.speaker-profiles').forEach(function(el) {
    el.style.opacity = '1';

	jQuery(function($) {
		const $overlay = $('.speaker-profile-overlay');
		const $modal   = $('#speaker-modal');

		const $photo   = $modal.find('.photo-modal');
		const $photo_img = $modal.find('.photo-modal img');
		const $name    = $modal.find('.modal-name');
		const $ctas    = $modal.find('.modal-ctas');
		const $lecture = $modal.find('.modal-lecture');
		const $hosted  = $modal.find('.modal-hosted');
		const $date    = $modal.find('.modal-date');
		const $loc     = $modal.find('.modal-location');
		const $website = $modal.find('.modal-website');
		const $email   = $modal.find('.modal-email');
		const $tabs    = $modal.find('.modal-tabs');

		// Open modal
		$(document).on('click', '.speaker-trigger', function(e) {
			e.preventDefault();

			const el = $(this);

			const img     = el.data('img');
			const name    = el.data('name');
			const link    = el.data('link');
			const lecture = el.data('lecture');
			const hosted  = el.data('hosted');
			const date    = el.data('date');
			const loc     = el.data('location');
			const tabs    = el.data('tabs') || {};
			const $design_emporium = el.data('design-emporium');
			const website = el.data('website');
			const email   = el.data('email');
			const additionalImages = el.data('additional-images') || [];

			// Destroy existing slick if initialized
			if ($photo.hasClass('slick-initialized')) {
				$photo.slick('unslick');
			}

			// Build carousel with main image + additional images
			var allImages = [];
			if (img) {
				allImages.push(img);
			}
			if (additionalImages && additionalImages.length) {
				allImages = allImages.concat(additionalImages);
			}

			// Populate photo area
			if ($design_emporium) {
				$photo_img.attr('src', img);
			} else if (allImages.length > 1) {
				// Multiple images - create carousel
				$photo.css('background-image', 'none'); // Clear background image
				var carouselHtml = '';
				allImages.forEach(function(imgUrl) {
					carouselHtml += '<div><img src="' + imgUrl + '" alt="" /></div>';
				});
				$photo.html(carouselHtml);
				$(document).ready(function() {
				$photo.slick({
					slidesToShow: 1,
					slidesToScroll: 1,
					infinite: true,
					dots: false,
					arrows: false,
					autoplay: true,
					autoplaySpeed: 3000,
					fade: true,
					adaptiveHeight: false
				});
				});
			} else {
				// Single image - use background
				$photo.html('');
				$photo.css('background-image', 'url(' + img + ')');
			}

			$name.text(name);

			$ctas.html(link ? '<a href="' + link + '" target="_blank">Book tickets</a>' : '');

			$lecture.html(lecture || '');
			$hosted.html(hosted ? 'Hosted by ' + hosted : '');
			$date.html(date || '');
			$loc.html(loc || '');

			// Website
			if (website) {
				var displayUrl = website.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');
				$website.html('<p>W: <a href="' + website + '">' + displayUrl + '</a></p>');
			} else {
				$website.html('');
			}

			// Email
			if (email) {
				$email.html('<p>E: <a href="mailto:' + email + '">' + email + '</a></p>');
			} else {
				$email.html('');
			}

			// Build tabs HTML  
			let tabsHtml = '';
			for (const key in tabs) {
				tabsHtml += '<div class="tab-content ' + key + '">' + tabs[key] + '</div>';
			}

			$tabs.html(tabsHtml);

			// Show modal
			$modal.addClass('active');
			$overlay.addClass('active');
		});

		// Close modal
		$(document).on('click', '.mfp-close, .speaker-profile-overlay', function() {
			$modal.removeClass('active');
			$overlay.removeClass('active');
		});

	});

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>What's On — ZODIAC Bar, Club & Karaoke · Camden</title>
<meta name="description" content="Drag, karaoke, DJ nights, Trans events and Eurovision — seven nights a week at Camden's queer venue. 119 Hampstead Road, NW1 3EE.">

<style>
/* ─── TOKENS ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
:root {
  --bg:       #080808;
  --surface:  #0f0f0f;
  --border:   rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  --border-md:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  --text:     #ebebeb;
  --sub:      #888;
  --dim:      #444;
  --accent:   #c060ff;
  --accent-lo:rgba(192,96,255,0.12);
  --live:     #22c55e;
  --gold:     #f0c040;
  --euv:      #009ee3;
  --warn:     #f59e0b;

  --r-sm: 6px;
  --r-md: 10px;
  --r-lg: 16px;

  --fam: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;

  /* Pride */
  --rainbow: linear-gradient(90deg,#FF0018,#FFA52C,#FFFF41,#008018,#0000F9,#86007D);
  --trans-blue: #55CDFC;
  --trans-pink: #F7A8B8;
  --bi-pink: #D60270;
  --bi-purple: #9B4F96;
  --bi-blue: #0038A8;
}

/* ─── RESET ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--fam);
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font-family:var(--fam);cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}

/* ─── UTILITY ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.u-label{
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
}
.u-dot{
  display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--live);
  animation:blink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px;
}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}
.u-sep{color:var(--dim);margin:0 .35em}

/* ─── NAV ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;
  height:56px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 24px;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.92);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.nav-logo{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  font-size:.85rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text);
}
.nav-links{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  list-style:none;
}
.nav-links li a{
  font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;
  color:var(--sub);
  padding:6px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  transition:color .15s;
}
.nav-links li a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.nav-links .nav-book a{
  background:var(--text);color:var(--bg);
  font-weight:700;padding:7px 16px;
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  transition:opacity .15s;
}
.nav-links .nav-book a:hover{opacity:.85}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .nav-links{display:none}
}

/* ─── TICKER ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ticker-rail{
  background:var(--surface);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  overflow:hidden;
  height:36px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;
}
.ticker-inner{
  display:flex;
  white-space:nowrap;
  animation:scroll-left 40s linear infinite;
  will-change:transform;
}
.ticker-inner:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
.ticker-item{
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  padding:0 24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.ticker-item .t-hi{color:var(--text)}
.ticker-item .t-accent{color:var(--accent)}
.ticker-item .t-euv{color:var(--euv)}
.ticker-item .t-gold{color:var(--gold)}
@keyframes scroll-left{
  0%{transform:translateX(0)}
  100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}
}

/* ─── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

  padding-top:56px;

  overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 50% -10%,rgba(192,96,255,.14) 0%,transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 30% at 85% 80%,rgba(0,158,227,.07) 0%,transparent 60%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
/* subtle grid */
.hero-bg::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:80px 80px;
}
.hero-inner{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;
  width:100%;
}
.hero-status{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);

.hero-h1{
  font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,6.5rem);
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;
  line-height:.95;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:28px;
}
.hero-h1 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:900}
.hero-sub{
  font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.5vw,1.1rem);
  color:var(--sub);
  max-width:520px;
  line-height:1.65;
  margin-bottom:36px;
}
.hero-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
  padding:11px 22px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  transition:all .15s;

}
.btn-primary{background:var(--text);color:var(--bg)}
.btn-primary:hover{opacity:.88}
.btn-ghost{
  color:var(--sub);

  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
}
.btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}

/* countdown strip */
.hero-countdown{
  margin-top:56px;
  padding-top:32px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.cd-label{
  font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  margin-right:32px;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.cd-units{display:flex;gap:0}
.cd-unit{
  text-align:center;padding:0 24px;
  border-right:1px solid var(--border);
}
.cd-unit:first-child{padding-left:0}
.cd-unit:last-child{border-right:none}
.cd-n{
  font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;
  color:var(--text);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.cd-t{
  font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);margin-top:3px;
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .cd-label{width:100%;margin-bottom:16px;margin-right:0}
  .cd-unit{padding:0 16px}
}

/* ─── SECTION WRAPPER ────────────────────────────────── */
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

/* ─── FEATURED STRIP ─────────────────────────────────── */
.featured{
  padding:80px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.feat-header{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;
  margin-bottom:40px;
}
.feat-h2{
  font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2rem);
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1;
}
.feat-h2 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:800}

/* two col grid */
.feat-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:1px;
  background:var(--border);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  overflow:hidden;
}
@media(max-width:720px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.feat-card{
  background:var(--bg);
  padding:36px 32px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
  min-height:340px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:background .2s;
}
.feat-card:hover{background:var(--surface)}
.feat-card-glow{
  position:absolute;
  top:-40%;left:-20%;
  width:60%;height:60%;
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.15;
  filter:blur(60px);
}
.fc-reopen .feat-card-glow{background:var(--accent)}
.fc-euv    .feat-card-glow{background:var(--euv)}
.feat-tag{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:4px 11px;border-radius:100px;
  align-self:flex-start;margin-bottom:24px;
}
.tag-reopen{
  background:rgba(192,96,255,.1);
  border:1px solid rgba(192,96,255,.25);

}
.tag-euv{

}
.feat-title{

.feat-meta{

.cap-live{

.cap-live::before{
  content:'';width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;

  flex-shrink:0;
}

/* inline btn */
.btn-invert{
  background:transparent;
  border:1px solid var(--border-md);
  color:var(--sub);
}
.btn-invert:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:var(--text)}

/* ─── FILTER BAR ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.filter-bar{
  position:sticky;top:56px;z-index:100;

  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);

.filter-inner{
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;

.filter-inner::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.f-btn{
  flex-shrink:0;
  padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;

<script>
// ── COUNTDOWN ─────────────────────────────────────────
function tick(){
  const target=new Date('2026-05-09T12:00:00');
  const diff=target-new Date();
  if(diff<=0){['d','h','m','s'].forEach(k=>document.getElementById('cd-'+k).textContent='00');return}
  const d=Math.floor(diff/864e5);
  const h=Math.floor(diff%864e5/36e5);
  const m=Math.floor(diff%36e5/6e4);
  const s=Math.floor(diff%6e4/1e3);
  document.getElementById('cd-d').textContent=String(d).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-h').textContent=String(h).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-m').textContent=String(m).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-s').textContent=String(s).padStart(2,'0');
}
tick();setInterval(tick,1000);

// ── FILTER ────────────────────────────────────────────
document.querySelectorAll('.f-btn').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.f-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('is-active'));
    btn.classList.add('is-active');
    const f=btn.dataset.f;
    document.querySelectorAll('.ev').forEach(ev=>{
      ev.classList.toggle('is-hidden', f!=='all' && ev.dataset.type!==f);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.month-block').forEach(mb=>{
      const visible=[...mb.querySelectorAll('.ev')].some(e=>!e.classList.contains('is-hidden'));
      mb.classList.toggle('is-hidden',!visible);
    });
  });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' rx='4' fill='%231a0040'/%3E%3Ctext x='16' y='24' font-family='Arial%2C sans-serif' font-weight='bold' font-size='20' fill='white' text-anchor='middle'%3EZ%3C%2Ftext%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>What's On — ZODIAC Bar, Club & Karaoke · Camden</title>
<meta name="description" content="Drag, karaoke, DJ nights, Trans events and Eurovision — seven nights a week at Camden's queer venue. 119 Hampstead Road, NW1 3EE.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:ital,opsz,wght@0,14..32,300;0,14..32,400;0,14..32,500;0,14..32,600;0,14..32,700;0,14..32,800;0,14..32,900;1,14..32,300;1,14..32,400;1,14..32,500;1,14..32,600;1,14..32,700;1,14..32,800;1,14..32,900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ─── TOKENS ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
:root {
  --bg:       #080808;
  --surface:  #0f0f0f;
  --border:   rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  --border-md:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  --text:     #ebebeb;
  --sub:      #888;
  --dim:      #444;
  --accent:   #c060ff;
  --accent-lo:rgba(192,96,255,0.12);
  --live:     #22c55e;
  --gold:     #f0c040;
  --euv:      #009ee3;
  --warn:     #f59e0b;

  --r-sm: 6px;
  --r-md: 10px;
  --r-lg: 16px;

  --fam: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;

  /* Pride */
  --rainbow: linear-gradient(90deg,#FF0018,#FFA52C,#FFFF41,#008018,#0000F9,#86007D);
  --trans-blue: #55CDFC;
  --trans-pink: #F7A8B8;
  --bi-pink: #D60270;
  --bi-purple: #9B4F96;
  --bi-blue: #0038A8;
}

/* ─── RESET ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--fam);
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font-family:var(--fam);cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}

/* ─── UTILITY ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.u-label{
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
}
.u-dot{
  display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--live);
  animation:blink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px;
}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}
.u-sep{color:var(--dim);margin:0 .35em}

/* ─── NAV ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;
  height:56px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 24px;
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.92);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.nav-logo{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  font-size:.85rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text);
}
.nav-links{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  list-style:none;
}
.nav-links li a{
  font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;
  color:var(--sub);
  padding:6px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  transition:color .15s;
}
.nav-links li a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.nav-links .nav-book a{
  background:var(--text);color:var(--bg);
  font-weight:700;padding:7px 16px;
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  transition:opacity .15s;
}
.nav-links .nav-book a:hover{opacity:.85}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .nav-links{display:none}
}

/* ─── TICKER ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ticker-rail{
  background:var(--surface);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  overflow:hidden;
  height:36px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;
}
.ticker-inner{
  display:flex;
  white-space:nowrap;
  animation:scroll-left 40s linear infinite;
  will-change:transform;
}
.ticker-inner:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
.ticker-item{
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  padding:0 24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.ticker-item .t-hi{color:var(--text)}
.ticker-item .t-accent{color:var(--accent)}
.ticker-item .t-euv{color:var(--euv)}
.ticker-item .t-gold{color:var(--gold)}
@keyframes scroll-left{
  0%{transform:translateX(0)}
  100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}
}

/* ─── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.hero{
  padding-top:56px;
  min-height:100svh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
  padding-bottom:72px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 50% -10%,rgba(192,96,255,.14) 0%,transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 30% at 85% 80%,rgba(0,158,227,.07) 0%,transparent 60%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
/* subtle grid */
.hero-bg::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:80px 80px;
}
.hero-inner{
  position:relative;z-index:2;
  max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;
  width:100%;
}
.hero-status{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  margin-bottom:32px;
}
.hero-h1{
  font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,6.5rem);
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;
  line-height:.95;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:28px;
}
.hero-h1 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:900}
.hero-sub{
  font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.5vw,1.1rem);
  color:var(--sub);
  max-width:520px;
  line-height:1.65;
  margin-bottom:36px;
}
.hero-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
  padding:11px 22px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  transition:all .15s;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.btn-primary{background:var(--text);color:var(--bg)}
.btn-primary:hover{opacity:.88}
.btn-ghost{
  color:var(--sub);
  border:1px solid var(--border-md);
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
}
.btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}

/* countdown strip */
.hero-countdown{
  margin-top:56px;
  padding-top:32px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.cd-label{
  font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  margin-right:32px;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.cd-units{display:flex;gap:0}
.cd-unit{
  text-align:center;padding:0 24px;
  border-right:1px solid var(--border);
}
.cd-unit:first-child{padding-left:0}
.cd-unit:last-child{border-right:none}
.cd-n{
  font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1;
  color:var(--text);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.cd-t{
  font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);margin-top:3px;
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .cd-label{width:100%;margin-bottom:16px;margin-right:0}
  .cd-unit{padding:0 16px}
}

/* ─── SECTION WRAPPER ────────────────────────────────── */
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

/* ─── FEATURED STRIP ─────────────────────────────────── */
.featured{
  padding:80px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.feat-header{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;
  margin-bottom:40px;
}
.feat-h2{
  font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2rem);
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1;
}
.feat-h2 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:800}

/* two col grid */
.feat-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:1px;
  background:var(--border);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  overflow:hidden;
}
@media(max-width:720px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.feat-card{
  background:var(--bg);
  padding:36px 32px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
  min-height:340px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:background .2s;
}
.feat-card:hover{background:var(--surface)}
.feat-card-glow{
  position:absolute;
  top:-40%;left:-20%;
  width:60%;height:60%;
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.15;
  filter:blur(60px);
}
.fc-reopen .feat-card-glow{background:var(--accent)}
.fc-euv    .feat-card-glow{background:var(--euv)}
.feat-tag{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:4px 11px;border-radius:100px;
  align-self:flex-start;margin-bottom:24px;
}
.tag-reopen{
  background:rgba(192,96,255,.1);
  border:1px solid rgba(192,96,255,.25);
  color:var(--accent);
}
.tag-euv{
  background:rgba(0,158,227,.1);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,158,227,.25);
  color:var(--euv);
}
.feat-date{
  font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sub);
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.feat-title{
  font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.5vw,1.8rem);
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1;

<script>
// ── COUNTDOWN ─────────────────────────────────────────
function tick(){
  const target=new Date('2026-05-09T12:00:00');
  const diff=target-new Date();
  if(diff<=0){['d','h','m','s'].forEach(k=>document.getElementById('cd-'+k).textContent='00');return}
  const d=Math.floor(diff/864e5);
  const h=Math.floor(diff%864e5/36e5);
  const m=Math.floor(diff%36e5/6e4);
  const s=Math.floor(diff%6e4/1e3);
  document.getElementById('cd-d').textContent=String(d).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-h').textContent=String(h).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-m').textContent=String(m).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-s').textContent=String(s).padStart(2,'0');
}
tick();setInterval(tick,1000);

// ── FILTER ────────────────────────────────────────────
document.querySelectorAll('.f-btn').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.f-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('is-active'));
    btn.classList.add('is-active');
    const f=btn.dataset.f;
    document.querySelectorAll('.ev').forEach(ev=>{
      ev.classList.toggle('is-hidden', f!=='all' && ev.dataset.type!==f);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.month-block').forEach(mb=>{
      const visible=[...mb.querySelectorAll('.ev')].some(e=>!e.classList.contains('is-hidden'));
      mb.classList.toggle('is-hidden',!visible);
    });
  });
});
</script>

  /* ===== CUSTOM CURSOR ===== */
  .cursor{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:18px;height:18px;border:1px solid var(--bone);border-radius:999px;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;mix-blend-mode:difference;transition:transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),width 0.18s,height 0.18s,background 0.18s;will-change:transform}
  .cursor.hover{width:54px;height:54px;background:var(--bone)}
  .cursor-label{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;transform:translate(-50%,calc(-50% - 36px));font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:10px;text-transform:lowercase;color:var(--bone);opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.2s ease}
  .cursor-label.show{opacity:1}
  @media (hover:none){.cursor,.cursor-label{display:none}}

  /* ===== TRANSMISSION COLD-OPEN ===== */
  .transmission{position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--ink);z-index:9000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;transition:opacity 0.7s ease,visibility 0.7s ease}
  .transmission.gone{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
  .tx-tag{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--magenta);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .tx-tag::before,.tx-tag::after{content:"";display:block;width:36px;height:1px;background:var(--magenta)}
  .tx-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(64px,14vw,200px);letter-spacing:-0.04em;line-height:0.85;color:var(--bone)}
  .tx-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--butter);display:inline-block;transform:translateY(-0.04em)}
  .tx-line{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(16px,2.4vw,28px);color:var(--bone-2);margin-top:24px;max-width:680px;line-height:1.35}
  .tx-cta{margin-top:48px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 28px;border:1px solid var(--bone);border-radius:999px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--bone);transition:background 0.2s,color 0.2s}
  .tx-cta:hover{background:var(--bone);color:var(--ink)}
  .tx-cta .arrow{transition:transform 0.3s}
  .tx-cta:hover .arrow{transform:translateX(6px)}
  .tx-bars{position:absolute;bottom:24px;left:24px;right:24px;display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:space-between;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:9px;color:rgba(244,241,232,0.4)}

  /* ===== MICROSITE NAV ===== */
  .ms-nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:80;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 24px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(11,15,31,0.88),rgba(11,15,31,0));backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
  .ms-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone);text-transform:lowercase}
  .ms-back .arr{transition:transform 0.25s}
  .ms-back:hover .arr{transform:translateX(-4px)}
  .ms-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone-2)}
  .ms-clock{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  .ms-clock .dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--magenta);animation:pulse 1.4s infinite}
  .ms-sound{cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(244,241,232,0.3);border-radius:999px;transition:border-color 0.2s,color 0.2s}
  .ms-sound:hover{border-color:var(--bone)}
  .ms-sound .bars{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;align-items:end}
  .ms-sound .bars span{width:2px;background:currentColor;display:block}
  .ms-sound .bars span:nth-child(1){height:6px}
  .ms-sound .bars span:nth-child(2){height:10px}
  .ms-sound .bars span:nth-child(3){height:7px}
  .ms-sound.on .bars span{animation:eq 0.8s ease-in-out infinite}
  .ms-sound.on .bars span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:0.15s}
  .ms-sound.on .bars span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:0.3s}
  @keyframes eq{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}50%{transform:scaleY(0.4)}}

  /* ===== HERO ===== */
  .hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;padding:120px 0 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;overflow:hidden}
  .hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:
    radial-gradient(800px circle at 15% 20%,rgba(255,45,135,0.18),transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(700px circle at 85% 70%,rgba(0,229,255,0.14),transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(500px circle at 60% 110%,rgba(247,233,139,0.10),transparent 60%);
    pointer-events:none}
  .hero-marquee{position:relative;border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid-rule);overflow:hidden;padding:14px 0;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--bone-2);white-space:nowrap}
  .hero-marquee .track{display:inline-flex;gap:48px;animation:marq 40s linear infinite}
  .hero-marquee .track span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:48px}
  .hero-marquee .track span::after{content:"●";color:var(--magenta);margin-left:48px}
  @keyframes marq{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
  .hero-stage{position:relative;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:48px 0}
  .hero-stage .container{width:100%}
  .hero-eyebrow{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--magenta);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .hero-eyebrow::before{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--magenta);display:inline-block}
  .hero-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(72px,16vw,260px);line-height:0.82;letter-spacing:-0.045em;color:var(--bone)}
  .hero-title .ht-1{display:block}
  .hero-title .ht-amp{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:300;color:var(--butter);font-size:0.7em;letter-spacing:-0.02em;display:inline-block;margin:0 0.05em}
  .hero-title .ht-2{display:block;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--bone)}
  .hero-title .ht-2 .dot{color:var(--magenta);font-style:normal}
  .hero-sub{margin-top:36px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:14px 28px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px);color:var(--bone-2);max-width:880px;line-height:1.35}
  .hero-sub strong{font-weight:600;color:var(--bone);font-style:normal;font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque'}
  .hero-meta-row{margin-top:48px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px;max-width:760px;border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule);padding-top:24px}
  .hm-cell{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
  .hm-cell .lbl{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7;text-transform:lowercase}
  .hm-cell .val{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:22px;color:var(--bone);letter-spacing:-0.01em}
  .hm-cell .val em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--butter)}
  .hero-cta{margin-top:48px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px}
  .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:18px 28px;border-radius:999px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:13px;text-transform:lowercase;transition:transform 0.25s ease,background 0.25s,color 0.25s,border-color 0.25s;will-change:transform}
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .btn .arrow{transition:transform 0.3s}
  .btn:hover .arrow{transform:translateX(6px)}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--magenta);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--magenta)}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--bone);border-color:var(--bone)}
  .btn-ghost{border:1px solid var(--bone);color:var(--bone)}
  .btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--bone);color:var(--ink)}
  .hero-countdown{position:absolute;bottom:96px;right:24px;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-end;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace}
  .cd-block{text-align:center}
  .cd-block .num{display:block;font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:46px;color:var(--bone);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.02em}
  .cd-block .lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7;margin-top:4px;text-transform:lowercase}
  .cd-sep{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:300;color:var(--magenta);font-size:46px;line-height:1;align-self:flex-start}
  .hero-bottom-marquee{border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule);overflow:hidden;padding:18px 0;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,72px);color:var(--bone);white-space:nowrap;line-height:1}
  .hero-bottom-marquee .track{display:inline-flex;gap:80px;animation:marq 28s linear infinite}
  .hero-bottom-marquee .track span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:80px}
  .hero-bottom-marquee .track span::after{content:"✺";color:var(--cyan);font-style:normal;margin-left:80px;font-family:'Major Mono Display'}

  @media (max-width:780px){
    .hero-meta-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}
    .hero-countdown{position:static;justify-content:flex-start;padding:32px 24px 0}
    .hero{min-height:auto;padding-bottom:60px}
  }

  /* ===== ACTS ===== */
  .acts{padding:120px 0 60px;position:relative}
  .act{position:relative;padding:100px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule)}
  .act:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid-rule)}
  .act-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:48px}
  .act-num{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:0.05em;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.6}
  .act-num strong{color:var(--bone);opacity:1;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
  .act-eye{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:24px}
  .act-1 .act-eye{background:rgba(255,45,135,0.12);color:var(--magenta);border:1px solid rgba(255,45,135,0.3)}
  .act-2 .act-eye{background:rgba(0,229,255,0.12);color:var(--cyan);border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.3)}
  .act-3 .act-eye{background:rgba(247,233,139,0.12);color:var(--butter);border:1px solid rgba(247,233,139,0.3)}
  .act-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,96px);line-height:0.94;letter-spacing:-0.03em;color:var(--bone);max-width:920px}
  .act-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400}
  .act-1 .act-title em{color:var(--magenta)}
  .act-2 .act-title em{color:var(--cyan)}
  .act-3 .act-title em{color:var(--butter)}
  .act-body{margin-top:32px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(18px,1.8vw,22px);line-height:1.55;color:var(--bone-2);max-width:680px}
  .act-stats{margin-top:48px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px;max-width:720px;border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule);padding-top:24px}
  .act-stat .num{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:48px;color:var(--bone);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.02em;display:block}
  .act-stat .num em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:28px;color:var(--bone-2);margin-left:4px}
  .act-stat .lbl{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.6;text-transform:lowercase;margin-top:8px;display:block}
  .act-cta{margin-top:40px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--bone);padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bone);transition:gap 0.25s}
  .act-cta:hover{gap:18px}
  .act-1 .act-cta{color:var(--magenta);border-color:var(--magenta)}
  .act-2 .act-cta{color:var(--cyan);border-color:var(--cyan)}
  .act-3 .act-cta{color:var(--butter);border-color:var(--butter)}

  @media (max-width:780px){
    .act-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
    .act-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .act{padding:60px 0}
  }

  /* ===== GAMES ===== */
  .games{padding:140px 0 60px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(255,45,135,0.04) 30%,transparent)}
  .games-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;margin-bottom:80px}
  .games-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--magenta);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .games-eye::before{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--magenta);display:inline-block}
  .games-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(48px,9vw,140px);line-height:0.9;letter-spacing:-0.04em;color:var(--bone)}
  .games-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--violet)}
  .games-sub{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:20px;color:var(--bone-2);max-width:420px;line-height:1.4}
  .game{padding:60px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule);display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:48px}
  .game:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid-rule)}
  .game-meta .num{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.6}
  .game-meta .lbl{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:24px;color:var(--bone);margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
  .game-meta .lbl em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--magenta)}
  .game-body h3{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,48px);line-height:0.96;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--bone);margin-bottom:18px;max-width:640px}
  .game-body h3 em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--butter)}
  .game-body p{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:18px;color:var(--bone-2);line-height:1.5;max-width:640px;margin-bottom:28px}

  /* sweepstake panel */
  .sweep{background:rgba(244,241,232,0.04);border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:8px;padding:28px;max-width:780px}
  .sweep-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:20px}
  .sweep-row input{flex:1;min-width:180px;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bone-2);padding:12px 4px;color:var(--bone);font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-size:18px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.01em;outline:none;transition:border-color 0.2s}
  .sweep-row input:focus{border-color:var(--magenta)}
  .sweep-row input::placeholder{color:rgba(244,241,232,0.4);font-style:italic;font-family:'Fraunces'}
  .sweep-row button{padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;text-transform:lowercase;transition:background 0.2s,color 0.2s}
  .sweep-pick{background:var(--cyan);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--cyan)}
  .sweep-pick:hover{background:var(--bone);border-color:var(--bone)}
  .sweep-lock{background:transparent;color:var(--bone);border:1px solid var(--bone)}
  .sweep-lock:hover{background:var(--magenta);border-color:var(--magenta);color:var(--ink)}
  .sweep-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:6px;margin-top:16px}
  .sweep-chip{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:6px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--bone-2);text-transform:lowercase;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 0.2s,color 0.2s,background 0.2s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  .sweep-chip:hover{border-color:var(--bone);color:var(--bone)}
  .sweep-chip.active{background:var(--magenta);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--magenta)}
  .sweep-chip .flag{font-size:14px;font-family:system-ui}
  .sweep-status{margin-top:18px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7}
  .sweep-status strong{color:var(--cyan);opacity:1}

  /* predictions */
  .pred{background:rgba(244,241,232,0.04);border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:8px;padding:28px;max-width:780px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:18px}
  .pred-cell label{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7;text-transform:lowercase;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
  .pred-cell input{width:100%;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bone-2);padding:8px 4px;color:var(--bone);font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-size:18px;font-weight:500;outline:none;transition:border-color 0.2s}
  .pred-cell input:focus{border-color:var(--cyan)}
  .pred-cell input::placeholder{color:rgba(244,241,232,0.4);font-style:italic;font-family:'Fraunces'}

  /* bingo */
  .bingo{background:rgba(247,233,139,0.04);border:1px solid rgba(247,233,139,0.2);border-radius:8px;padding:28px;max-width:780px}
  .bingo-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:16px}
  .bingo-cell{aspect-ratio:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:4px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone-2);line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.25s,color 0.25s,border-color 0.25s}
  .bingo-cell.free{background:var(--butter);color:var(--ink);font-family:'Major Mono Display';font-style:normal;text-transform:lowercase;font-size:10px;border-color:var(--butter)}
  .bingo-cell.marked{background:var(--magenta);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--magenta)}
  .bingo-foot{margin-top:16px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7}

  @media (max-width:780px){
    .game{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}
  }

  /* ===== ADDITIONAL GAMES (photo / drink / flag) ===== */
  .game-mini{background:rgba(244,241,232,0.04);border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:8px;padding:28px;max-width:780px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:18px}
  .game-mini label{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7;text-transform:lowercase;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
  .game-mini input,.game-mini textarea,.game-mini select{width:100%;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bone-2);padding:8px 4px;color:var(--bone);font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-size:16px;font-weight:500;outline:none;transition:border-color 0.2s;resize:vertical}
  .game-mini input:focus,.game-mini textarea:focus,.game-mini select:focus{border-color:var(--cyan)}
  .game-mini input::placeholder,.game-mini textarea::placeholder{color:rgba(244,241,232,0.4);font-style:italic;font-family:'Fraunces'}
  .game-mini .checkrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:6px}
  .game-mini .checkrow input{width:auto}
  .game-why{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.75;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.4}
  .game-why strong{color:var(--cyan);font-style:normal;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:10px;text-transform:lowercase;letter-spacing:0.05em}

  /* ===== CAPTURE SECTION (come as you are · consent · save) ===== */
  .capture{padding:120px 0 140px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(0,229,255,0.05) 50%,transparent);border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid-rule)}
  .cap-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .cap-eye::before{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--cyan);display:inline-block}
  .cap-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,96px);line-height:0.92;letter-spacing:-0.035em;color:var(--bone);max-width:900px;margin-bottom:24px}
  .cap-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--cyan)}
  .cap-sub{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:20px;color:var(--bone-2);max-width:680px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:48px}
  .cap-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;margin-bottom:48px}
  @media (max-width:880px){.cap-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}}
  .cap-card{background:rgba(244,241,232,0.04);border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:8px;padding:32px}
  .cap-card-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:22px;color:var(--bone);margin-bottom:6px}
  .cap-card-sub{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:15px;color:var(--bone-2);margin-bottom:24px;line-height:1.4}
  .cap-row{margin-bottom:22px}
  .cap-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
  .cap-label{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.85;text-transform:lowercase;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
  .cap-label em{font-style:normal;color:var(--cyan);opacity:0.8;margin-left:6px}
  .cap-row input,.cap-row textarea{width:100%;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bone-2);padding:10px 4px;color:var(--bone);font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-size:18px;font-weight:500;outline:none;transition:border-color 0.2s;resize:vertical}
  .cap-row input:focus,.cap-row textarea:focus{border-color:var(--cyan)}
  .cap-row input::placeholder,.cap-row textarea::placeholder{color:rgba(244,241,232,0.4);font-style:italic;font-family:'Fraunces'}
  .cap-why{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.75;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.45}
  .cap-consent{margin-top:32px;padding:24px;border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.25);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(0,229,255,0.04)}
  .cap-consent .cap-consent-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:0.05em}
  .cap-check{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Fraunces';font-size:16px;color:var(--bone);line-height:1.5}
  .cap-check input[type="checkbox"]{margin-top:4px;accent-color:var(--cyan);width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer}
  .cap-check input[type="checkbox"]:disabled{opacity:0.6}
  .cap-foot{margin-top:18px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:14px;color:var(--bone-2);line-height:1.5}
  .cap-foot a{color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:3px}
  .cap-foot a:hover{color:var(--bone)}
  .cap-save-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin-top:32px}
  .cap-save-status{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7}
  .cap-save-status.ok{color:var(--cyan);opacity:1}
  .cap-save-status.err{color:var(--magenta);opacity:1}
  .cap-receipts{margin-top:40px;padding:32px;border:1px solid var(--cyan);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(0,229,255,0.06)}
  .cap-receipts-head{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:24px;color:var(--bone);margin-bottom:8px}
  .cap-receipts-head em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--cyan)}
  .cap-receipts-sub{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:15px;color:var(--bone-2);margin-bottom:24px}
  .cap-receipt{padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center}
  .cap-receipt:first-child{border-top:0}
  .cap-receipt-game{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:17px;color:var(--bone)}
  .cap-receipt-detail{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:14px;color:var(--bone-2);margin-top:4px}
  .cap-receipt-code{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(0,229,255,0.10);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;letter-spacing:0.05em;white-space:nowrap}

  /* ===== ROOM (anti-xenophobia) ===== */
  .room{background:var(--bone);color:var(--ink);padding:140px 0 120px;position:relative}
  .room-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--magenta);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .room-eye::before{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--magenta);display:inline-block}
  .room-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(56px,11vw,180px);line-height:0.86;letter-spacing:-0.045em;color:var(--ink);max-width:1100px}
  .room-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--magenta)}
  .room-lede{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px);line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink);max-width:780px;margin-top:48px}
  .room-rules{margin-top:80px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:48px 64px;border-top:1px solid rgba(11,15,31,0.2);padding-top:48px}
  .room-rule{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:start}
  .room-rule .rn{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:14px;color:var(--magenta)}
  .room-rule .rt{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:20px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;line-height:1.25}
  .room-rule .rt em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400}
  .room-rule .rb{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(11,15,31,0.78)}
  .room-coda{margin-top:96px;border-top:1px solid rgba(11,15,31,0.2);padding-top:48px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(24px,3.4vw,44px);line-height:1.25;color:var(--ink);max-width:920px}
  .room-coda strong{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-style:normal;color:var(--magenta);letter-spacing:-0.02em}
  .room-sign{margin-top:32px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:rgba(11,15,31,0.6);text-transform:lowercase}

  @media (max-width:780px){
    .room-rules{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}
  }

  /* ===== BOARDING (tickets) ===== */
  .boarding{padding:140px 0 80px;position:relative}
  .boarding-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:24px;margin-bottom:48px}
  .boarding-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .boarding-eye::before{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--cyan);display:inline-block}
  .boarding-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(48px,9vw,140px);line-height:0.9;letter-spacing:-0.04em;color:var(--bone)}
  .boarding-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--cyan)}
  .boarding-route{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:14px;color:var(--bone-2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:18px}
  .boarding-route .arr{color:var(--cyan)}
  .boarding-tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:32px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid-rule);padding-bottom:18px}
  .b-tab{padding:14px 22px;border-radius:999px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone-2);text-transform:lowercase;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);transition:all 0.2s;background:transparent}
  .b-tab:hover{border-color:var(--bone);color:var(--bone)}
  .b-tab.active{background:var(--bone);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--bone)}
  .boarding-quantity{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:999px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--bone);margin-bottom:32px}
  .boarding-quantity button{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--bone-2);font-size:14px;line-height:1;color:var(--bone)}
  .boarding-quantity button:hover{background:var(--magenta);border-color:var(--magenta);color:var(--ink)}
  .boarding-quantity .qv{min-width:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--bone)}
  .boarding-tiers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:20px}
  .b-tier{position:relative;background:rgba(244,241,232,0.04);border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:14px;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;transition:transform 0.25s,border-color 0.25s,background 0.25s;overflow:hidden}
  .b-tier:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--bone);background:rgba(244,241,232,0.06)}
  .b-tier.featured{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,229,255,0.10),rgba(0,229,255,0.02));border-color:rgba(0,229,255,0.4)}
  .b-tier.featured::before{content:"top pick";position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:9px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--cyan);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;text-transform:lowercase}
  .b-tier .b-stub{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:30px;width:1px;border-left:1px dashed rgba(244,241,232,0.18);pointer-events:none}
  .b-tier .b-corner{position:absolute;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--grid-rule)}
  .b-tier .b-corner.tl{top:-10px;left:20px}
  .b-tier .b-corner.bl{bottom:-10px;left:20px}
  .b-tier-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7;text-transform:lowercase;padding-left:12px}
  .b-tier-name{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--bone);padding-left:12px}
  .b-tier-name em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--cyan)}
  .b-tier-price{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:54px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.03em;color:var(--bone);padding-left:12px}
  .b-tier-price .gbp{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--bone-2);font-size:24px;margin-right:4px}
  .b-tier-list{padding-left:12px;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:15px;color:var(--bone-2);line-height:1.4;border-top:1px dashed rgba(244,241,232,0.18);padding-top:18px}
  .b-tier-list li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:start}
  .b-tier-list li::before{content:"·";color:var(--cyan);font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-size:18px;line-height:1.1}
  .b-tier .btn{margin-top:auto;margin-left:12px;align-self:flex-start}
  .b-empty{padding:48px 24px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed var(--grid-rule);border-radius:14px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;color:var(--bone-2)}

  /* ===== KIOSK (bundles) ===== */
  .kiosk{padding:120px 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(247,233,139,0.04),transparent)}
  .kiosk-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--butter);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .kiosk-eye::before{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--butter);display:inline-block}
  .kiosk-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,108px);line-height:0.9;letter-spacing:-0.04em;color:var(--bone)}
  .kiosk-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--butter)}
  .kiosk-sub{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:18px;color:var(--bone-2);max-width:560px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:24px}
  .kiosk-grid{margin-top:64px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px}
  .bundle{background:rgba(244,241,232,0.04);border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:14px;padding:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;transition:transform 0.25s,border-color 0.25s}
  .bundle:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--butter)}
  .bundle .glyph{font-size:36px;font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:300;color:var(--butter);line-height:1}
  .bundle h4{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:22px;color:var(--bone);letter-spacing:-0.01em}
  .bundle h4 em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--butter)}
  .bundle p{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:15px;color:var(--bone-2);line-height:1.45;flex:1}
  .bundle .price{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:32px;color:var(--bone);letter-spacing:-0.02em}
  .bundle .price .gbp{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--bone-2);font-size:18px;margin-right:2px}
  .bundle .price .strike{font-size:14px;color:var(--bone-2);text-decoration:line-through;font-family:'Major Mono Display';margin-left:10px;font-weight:400}
  .bundle .b-add{align-self:flex-start;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--bone);color:var(--bone);font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;transition:background 0.2s,color 0.2s}
  .bundle .b-add:hover{background:var(--butter);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--butter)}

  /* ===== CREW ===== */
  .crew{padding:140px 0 80px}
  .crew-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--violet);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .crew-eye::before{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--violet);display:inline-block}
  .crew-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(40px,8vw,120px);line-height:0.9;letter-spacing:-0.04em;color:var(--bone)}
  .crew-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--violet)}
  .crew-sub{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:18px;color:var(--bone-2);max-width:680px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:24px}
  .crew-strip{margin-top:64px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
  .crew-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:999px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--bone);text-transform:lowercase;background:rgba(181,156,255,0.04)}
  .crew-chip .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--violet);display:inline-block;animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
  .crew-foot{margin-top:48px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:16px;color:var(--bone-2);max-width:780px;line-height:1.5}
  .crew-link{color:var(--cyan);border-bottom:1px dashed var(--cyan);padding-bottom:1px;transition:color 0.2s,border-color 0.2s}
  .crew-link:hover{color:var(--magenta);border-bottom-color:var(--magenta)}

  /* PROMOTER OVERLAY (private) */
  .promoter-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(8,8,16,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);z-index:9000;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:48px 20px;overflow-y:auto;animation:fadeIn 0.3s ease}
  .promoter-overlay[hidden]{display:none}
  @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
  .promoter-card{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:760px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,45,135,0.08),rgba(0,229,255,0.04) 50%,rgba(181,156,255,0.06));border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:24px;padding:48px 40px 40px;color:var(--bone)}
  .promoter-close{position:absolute;top:16px;right:18px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:50%;width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--bone);font-size:24px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s,border-color 0.2s}
  .promoter-close:hover{background:rgba(255,45,135,0.16);border-color:var(--magenta)}
  .promoter-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--violet);text-transform:lowercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .promoter-eye::before{content:"";width:36px;height:1px;background:var(--violet);display:inline-block}
  .promoter-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(36px,6vw,56px);line-height:0.95;letter-spacing:-0.03em;color:var(--bone)}
  .promoter-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--magenta)}
  .promoter-sub{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:18px;color:var(--bone-2);margin-top:14px;line-height:1.5}
  .promoter-link-row{margin-top:28px;padding:20px;border:1px dashed var(--cyan);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(0,229,255,0.04)}
  .promoter-link-label{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:10px}
  .promoter-link-box{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .promoter-link-box code{flex:1;min-width:0;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--bone);overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all}
  .promoter-copy{background:var(--cyan);color:var(--ink);border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 18px;font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:11px;text-transform:lowercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s}
  .promoter-copy:hover{background:var(--magenta);color:var(--bone)}
  .promoter-copy.copied{background:var(--violet);color:var(--ink)}
  .promoter-link-foot{margin-top:12px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:var(--bone-2)}
  .promoter-tiers{margin-top:32px;display:grid;gap:14px}
  .tier{padding:20px 22px;border:1px solid var(--grid-rule);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(181,156,255,0.03);transition:transform 0.25s,border-color 0.25s,background 0.25s}
  .tier:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--violet);background:rgba(181,156,255,0.08)}
  .tier-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .tier-num{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--magenta);text-transform:lowercase}
  .tier-name{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:22px;color:var(--bone);letter-spacing:-0.01em}
  .tier-range{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:14px;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:10px}
  .tier-perks{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:6px}
  .tier-perks li{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-size:14px;color:var(--bone-2);padding-left:18px;position:relative;line-height:1.4}
  .tier-perks li::before{content:"·";position:absolute;left:6px;top:-2px;color:var(--violet);font-size:18px}
  .promoter-foot{margin-top:24px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:14px;color:var(--bone-2);line-height:1.5}
  @media(max-width:640px){
    .promoter-card{padding:36px 22px 28px}
    .promoter-link-box{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
    .promoter-copy{align-self:flex-start}
  }

  @media (max-width:780px){
    .crew-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px;padding:20px 0}
    .crew-row .cn{display:none}
    .crew-row .pct{font-size:28px}
  }

  /* ===== FAQ ===== */
  .faq{padding:120px 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(11,15,31,0.6))}
  .faq-eye{font-family:'Major Mono Display',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--bone-2);opacity:0.7;text-transform:lowercase;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .faq-eye::before{content:"";width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--bone-2);display:inline-block}
  .faq-title{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,108px);line-height:0.9;letter-spacing:-0.04em;color:var(--bone)}
  .faq-title em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--cyan)}
  .faq-list{margin-top:48px;border-top:1px solid var(--grid-rule)}
  .faq-list details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid-rule);padding:24px 0}
  .faq-list summary{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:24px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,28px);color:var(--bone);letter-spacing:-0.01em;line-height:1.3}
  .faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .faq-list summary .glyph{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:300;font-size:32px;color:var(--magenta);line-height:1;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform 0.3s}
  .faq-list details[open] summary .glyph{transform:rotate(45deg)}
  .faq-list .ans{margin-top:18px;font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:17px;color:var(--bone-2);line-height:1.55;max-width:840px}

  /* ===== SIGN-OFF ===== */
  .signoff{padding:140px 0 0;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .signoff-mark{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(72px,18vw,260px);line-height:0.86;letter-spacing:-0.045em;color:var(--bone)}
  .signoff-mark em{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:var(--magenta)}
  .signoff-line{font-family:'Fraunces';font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,32px);color:var(--bone-2);max-width:680px;margin:32px auto 0;line-height:1.4}

        <div>
          <div class="rt">Cheer <em>for</em>, not <em>against</em>.</div>
          <div class="rb">Boo a song, not a country. Heckle a key change, not a people. We are scoring Eurovision, not borders.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="room-rule">
        <div class="rn">02</div>
        <div>
          <div class="rt">No slurs. No exceptions.</div>
          <div class="rb">Racist, homophobic, transphobic, antisemitic, Islamophobic, ableist or misogynist language gets you removed. There is no "but it was a joke" version of this rule.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="room-rule">
        <div class="rn">03</div>
        <div>
          <div class="rt">Costume = celebration.</div>
          <div class="rb">Dress as the country you love. Do not dress as a stereotype of a people. We will tell you the difference at the door if you're not sure — ask.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="room-rule">
        <div class="rn">04</div>
        <div>
          <div class="rt">Pronouns are <em>house policy</em>.</div>
          <div class="rb">Misgendering is not a debate. If someone tells you their pronouns, use them. ZODIAC is Trans-founded, by Jade Phoenix Hoskins — that is not a marketing line, it is the room.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="room-rule">
        <div class="rn">05</div>
        <div>
          <div class="rt">Genocide is not a <em>scoring</em> opinion.</div>
          <div class="rb">We will not stage debates about who deserves to exist. If a country is in Eurovision, it gets a chip on the rack. Take your geopolitics outside, gently and respectfully.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="room-rule">
        <div class="rn">06</div>
        <div>
          <div class="rt">Drinks are <em>optional</em>.</div>
          <div class="rb">Sober? You're welcome. We have alcohol-free pours and the same scoring power. No pressure, no smirk, same room.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="room-rule">
        <div class="rn">07</div>
        <div>
          <div class="rt">Tell the staff. Always.</div>
          <div class="rb">Something off? Find Dee on the floor or any staff in black. We act fast. We believe you. We don't need a long explanation.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="room-rule">
        <div class="rn">08</div>
        <div>
          <div class="rt">Photography & consent.</div>
          <div class="rb">Photos in costume zones, not in conversation zones. If someone covers their face, that's a no. Tag the venue, not strangers, on socials.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p class="room-coda"><strong>If this makes you uncomfortable, please keep walking.</strong> Peace and love. We are protecting the people in this room — including, especially, the ones who needed somewhere safe to scream "douze points" tonight.</p>

  function chime(){
    try{
      if(!state.audioCtx){state.audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();}
      var ctx = state.audioCtx;
      var notes = [392, 523.25, 659.25, 784];
      notes.forEach(function(f, i){
        var o = ctx.createOscillator();
        var g = ctx.createGain();
        o.frequency.value = f;
        o.type = 'sine';
        o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
        var t = ctx.currentTime + i*0.18;
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
        g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.06, t + 0.02);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.5);
        o.start(t); o.stop(t + 0.55);
      });
    }catch(e){}
  }

  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){

        e.target.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(function(n){
          var target = parseInt(n.getAttribute('data-count'),10);
          var start = 0;
          var dur = 1100; var t0 = performance.now();
          function step(t){
            var p = Math.min(1, (t - t0)/dur);
            var v = Math.round(start + (target - start) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3)));
            n.textContent = v;
            if(p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
          }
          requestAnimationFrame(step);
        });
        io.unobserve(e.target);
