        '</div>';
      kioskGrid.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
    });
  }
  renderKiosk();

  /* ============================================================
     GAMES CAPTURE — posts every played game to /api/zodiac-games
     ============================================================ */
  // ISO-3166 mapping for the lowercase country names used in sweepstake/predictions UI.
  // Anything unmapped is dropped (the API rejects unknown country codes).
  var COUNTRY_TO_ISO = {
    'united kingdom':'GB','ireland':'IE','france':'FR','germany':'DE','italy':'IT','spain':'ES',
    'sweden':'SE','norway':'NO','finland':'FI','denmark':'DK','iceland':'IS','netherlands':'NL',
    'belgium':'BE','luxembourg':'LU','austria':'AT','switzerland':'CH','portugal':'PT','greece':'GR',
    'cyprus':'CY','malta':'MT','poland':'PL','czechia':'CZ','croatia':'HR','slovenia':'SI',
    'albania':'AL','moldova':'MD','ukraine':'UA','georgia':'GE','armenia':'AM','azerbaijan':'AZ',
    'israel':'IL','australia':'AU','san marino':'SM','estonia':'EE','latvia':'LV','lithuania':'LT',
    'serbia':'RS'
  };
  function toIso(name){
    if(!name) return null;
    var k = String(name).toLowerCase().trim();
    return COUNTRY_TO_ISO[k] || null;
  }

  function buildGamesPayloads(){
    var payloads = [];
    var capEmail    = (document.getElementById('capEmail')||{}).value || '';
    var capName     = (document.getElementById('capName')||{}).value || '';
    var capPronouns = (document.getElementById('capPronouns')||{}).value || '';
    var capAccess   = (document.getElementById('capAccess')||{}).value || '';
    var capMarketing = !!(document.getElementById('capConsentMarketing')||{}).checked;
    var commonIdentity = {
      email: capEmail, name: capName, pronouns: capPronouns,
      accessibility: capAccess,
      consent: { marketing: capMarketing },
      ref: state.ref || null,
    };

    // 1. country-pick (sweepstake)
    if(state.sweepCountry){
      var iso = toIso(state.sweepCountry);
      if(iso) payloads.push(Object.assign({}, commonIdentity, {
        game:'country-pick', country:iso
      }));
    }

    // 2. prediction-pot (top 3 of the 5 ranked predictions)
    var topRanked = ['1','2','3'].map(function(r){return state.predictions[r];}).filter(Boolean);
    if(topRanked.length === 3){
      var top3iso = topRanked.map(toIso).filter(Boolean);
      if(top3iso.length === 3){
        var p = Object.assign({}, commonIdentity, { game:'prediction-pot', top_3: top3iso });
        // douze_winner = #1
        if(top3iso[0]) p.douze_winner = top3iso[0];
        payloads.push(p);
      }
    }

    // 3. drag-bingo
    var bingoNight = (document.getElementById('bingoNight')||{}).value || '';
    if(bingoNight){
      payloads.push(Object.assign({}, commonIdentity, {
        game:'drag-bingo',
        night:bingoNight,
        cards_count: parseInt((document.getElementById('bingoCards')||{}).value || '1', 10) || 1,
        bonus_card: !!(document.getElementById('bingoBonus')||{}).checked,
      }));
    }

    // 4. photo-pack — REQUIRES delivery email
    var photoEmail = (document.getElementById('photoEmail')||{}).value || '';
    if(photoEmail && /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(photoEmail.trim())){
      var photoBooth = (document.getElementById('photoBooth')||{}).value || '';
      var photoGroupRaw = (document.getElementById('photoGroup')||{}).value || '';
      var photoGroup = parseInt(photoGroupRaw, 10);
      var pp = Object.assign({}, commonIdentity, {
        game:'photo-pack',
        delivery_email: photoEmail.trim(),
      });
      if(photoBooth) pp.booth_pref = photoBooth;
      if(Number.isFinite(photoGroup) && photoGroup >= 1 && photoGroup <= 12) pp.group_size = photoGroup;
      payloads.push(pp);
    }

    // 5. drink-trio
    var drinkNights = [];
    ['drinkSemi1','drinkSemi2','drinkFinal'].forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if(el && el.checked) drinkNights.push(el.value);
    });
    if(drinkNights.length){
      var dt = Object.assign({}, commonIdentity, { game:'drink-trio', nights: drinkNights });
      var allergens = (document.getElementById('drinkAllergens')||{}).value || '';
      if(allergens) dt.allergens = allergens;
      if((document.getElementById('drinkAlcoholFree')||{}).checked) dt.alcohol_free = true;
      var flav = (document.getElementById('drinkFlavour')||{}).value || '';
      if(flav) dt.flavour_pref = flav;
      payloads.push(dt);
    }

    // 6. flag-pack
    var flagCountry = (document.getElementById('flagCountry')||{}).value || '';
    if(flagCountry){
      var fp = Object.assign({}, commonIdentity, { game:'flag-pack', country_pref: flagCountry });
      var sz = (document.getElementById('flagSize')||{}).value || '';
      if(sz) fp.size_pref = sz;
      payloads.push(fp);
    }

    return payloads;
  }

  function renderReceipts(receipts){
    var box = document.getElementById('capReceipts');
    var body = document.getElementById('capReceiptsBody');
    if(!box || !body) return;
    if(!receipts.length){box.hidden = true; return;}
    body.innerHTML = '';
    receipts.forEach(function(r){
      var detailParts = [];
      if(r.locked_in){
        Object.keys(r.locked_in).forEach(function(k){
          var v = r.locked_in[k];
          if(Array.isArray(v)) v = v.join(', ');
          if(typeof v === 'boolean') v = v ? 'yes' : 'no';
          detailParts.push(k.replace(/_/g,' ')+': '+v);
        });
      }
      var detail = detailParts.join(' · ');
      var stored = [];
      if(r.your_data){
        if(r.your_data.email_stored) stored.push('email');
        if(r.your_data.name_stored) stored.push('name');
        if(r.your_data.pronouns_stored) stored.push('pronouns');
        if(r.your_data.accessibility_stored) stored.push('accessibility note');
      }
      var html = '<div class="cap-receipt">' +
        '<div>' +
          '<div class="cap-receipt-game">'+(r.game_label||r.game)+'</div>' +
          '<div class="cap-receipt-detail">'+detail+'</div>' +
          (stored.length ? '<div class="cap-receipt-detail" style="color:var(--cyan);opacity:0.85">stored: '+stored.join(', ')+' · '+(r.retention_days||90)+'d retention</div>' : '<div class="cap-receipt-detail" style="color:var(--cyan);opacity:0.6">stored: nothing personal · receipt-only</div>') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="cap-receipt-code">'+r.receipt+'</div>' +
        '</div>';
      body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
    });
    box.hidden = false;
  }

  var capSave = document.getElementById('capSave');
  var capSaveStatus = document.getElementById('capSaveStatus');
  if(capSave) capSave.addEventListener('click', function(){
    capSaveStatus.classList.remove('ok','err');
    var payloads = buildGamesPayloads();
    if(!payloads.length){
      capSaveStatus.classList.add('err');
      capSaveStatus.textContent = 'no plays detected · pick a country, fill predictions, mark a bingo night, or pick a flag';
      return;
    }
    capSave.disabled = true;
    var origLabel = capSave.querySelector('span').textContent;
    capSave.querySelector('span').textContent = 'saving '+payloads.length+' game'+(payloads.length===1?'':'s')+'…';
    capSaveStatus.textContent = 'sending '+payloads.length+' play'+(payloads.length===1?'':'s')+' to ZODIAC…';

    Promise.all(payloads.map(function(p){
      return fetch('/api/zodiac-games',{
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body:JSON.stringify(p)
      }).then(function(r){return r.json().then(function(j){return {status:r.status, body:j, game:p.game};});})
        .catch(function(e){return {status:0, body:{error:'network'}, game:p.game};});
    })).then(function(results){
      var ok = results.filter(function(r){return r.status === 200 && r.body && r.body.ok;});
      var err = results.filter(function(r){return !(r.status === 200 && r.body && r.body.ok);});
      renderReceipts(ok.map(function(r){return r.body;}));
      if(ok.length && !err.length){
        capSaveStatus.classList.add('ok');
        capSaveStatus.textContent = 'saved · '+ok.length+' play'+(ok.length===1?'':'s')+' locked in · receipts below';
        if(state.soundOn) chime();
        try{if(typeof gtag === 'function') gtag('event','game_play_recorded',{count:ok.length, marketing_consent: !!document.getElementById('capConsentMarketing').checked});}catch(e){}
      } else if(ok.length && err.length){
        capSaveStatus.classList.add('ok');
        capSaveStatus.textContent = ok.length+' saved · '+err.length+' had errors ('+err.map(function(r){return r.game+': '+(r.body.error||'?');}).join(', ')+')';
      } else {
        capSaveStatus.classList.add('err');
        capSaveStatus.textContent = 'save failed · '+(err[0] && err[0].body && err[0].body.error || 'unknown')+' · email hello@zodiacbar.co.uk if it persists';
      }
    }).finally(function(){
      capSave.disabled = false;
      capSave.querySelector('span').textContent = origLabel;
    });
  });

  /* ============================================================
     INIT
     ============================================================ */
  pickRef();

})();
</script>

<script>
// Scroll reveal
const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('visible'); obs.unobserve(e.target); } });
}, { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));

// FAQ accordion
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const item = btn.closest('.faq-item');
    const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
    if (!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
  });
});

// Mobile nav
const burger=document.getElementById('burger');
const mobileMenu=document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
burger.addEventListener('click',()=>{burger.classList.toggle('open');mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open')});

// Form submission — sends to HubSpot via their Forms API
// Replace PORTAL_ID and FORM_GUID with values from HubSpot once form is created
const HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID   = '148132460';
const HUBSPOT_FORM_GUID   = 'FORM_GUID'; // TODO: replace with GUID from HubSpot form once created
const HUBSPOT_ENDPOINT    = `https://api.hsforms.com/submissions/v3/integration/submit/${HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID}/${HUBSPOT_FORM_GUID}`;

document.getElementById('promoterForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const form = e.target;
  const btn = form.querySelector('.submit-btn');
  btn.textContent = 'Sending...';
  btn.disabled = true;

  // Collect checked nights
  const nights = [...form.querySelectorAll('input[name="nights"]:checked')]
    .map(cb => cb.value).join(', ');

  const fields = [
    { name: 'firstname',     value: form.firstname.value },
    { name: 'email',         value: form.email.value },
    { name: 'phone',         value: form.phone.value },
    { name: 'stage_name',    value: form.stage_name.value },
    { name: 'instagram',     value: form.instagram.value },
    { name: 'event_type',    value: form.event_type.value },
    { name: 'tier',          value: form.tier.value },
    { name: 'preferred_nights', value: nights },
    { name: 'audience_size', value: form.audience_size.value },
    { name: 'pitch',         value: form.pitch.value },
    { name: 'heard_from',    value: form.heard_from.value },
  ].filter(f => f.value);

  const payload = {
    fields,
    context: { pageUri: window.location.href, pageName: document.title }
  };

  try {
    // If HubSpot IDs are placeholders, simulate success for demo
    let ok = false;
    if (HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID === 'PORTAL_ID') {
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800));
      ok = true;
    } else {
      const res = await fetch(HUBSPOT_ENDPOINT, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
      ok = res.ok;
    }

    if (ok) {
      form.style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('formSuccess').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('formSuccess').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    } else {
      throw new Error('Submission failed');
    }
  } catch {
    btn.textContent = 'Submit Application →';
    btn.disabled = false;
    alert('Something went wrong — please email us directly at enquiries@zodiacbarlondon.com');
  }
});
</script>

    banner.style.border = '1px solid rgba(85,205,252,.25)';
    banner.style.color = '#55CDFC';
    bannerHtml = '● We're open right now · ' + TODAY + ' slots have lower competition · Fast-track applications reviewed tonight';
    depositUrl = 'https://buy.stripe.com/7sYcMX9kvcMTfbLcg44ko15'; // promoter deposit
  } else if (IS_MIDWEEK && IS_DAY) {
    banner.style.background = 'rgba(201,168,76,.07)';
    banner.style.border = '1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.22)';
    banner.style.color = '#C9A84C';
    bannerHtml = '● ' + TODAY + ' is a lower-competition night · Apply now for a faster response';
    depositUrl = 'https://buy.stripe.com/7sYcMX9kvcMTfbLcg44ko15';
  } else if (IS_WEEKEND && IS_EVE) {
    banner.style.background = 'rgba(247,168,184,.08)';
    banner.style.border = '1px solid rgba(247,168,184,.25)';
    banner.style.color = '#F7A8B8';
    bannerHtml = '● ' + TODAY + ' · Peak night · High demand · Apply now — we review between sets';
  } else if (IS_WEEKEND && IS_DAY) {
    banner.style.background = 'rgba(197,108,240,.08)';
    banner.style.border = '1px solid rgba(197,108,240,.25)';
    banner.style.color = '#C56CF0';
    bannerHtml = '● Weekend applications reviewed by Monday · Submit today for priority review';
  } else {
    banner.style.background = 'rgba(107,203,119,.07)';
    banner.style.border = '1px solid rgba(107,203,119,.2)';
    banner.style.color = '#6BCB77';
    bannerHtml = '● Applications open · Typical response within 48 hours';
  }

  banner.innerHTML = bannerHtml;
  const formGrid = formSection.querySelector('.wrap');
  if (formGrid) formGrid.insertBefore(banner, formGrid.firstChild);

  /* ── Fast-track deposit CTA for midweek ─────────────── */
  if (IS_MIDWEEK && depositUrl) {
    const ftBlock = document.createElement('div');
    ftBlock.style.cssText = [
      'margin-top:20px','padding:16px 20px',
      'background:rgba(85,205,252,.06)',
      'border:1px solid rgba(85,205,252,.2)',
      'border-left:3px solid #55CDFC'
    ].join(';');
    ftBlock.innerHTML = [
      '<p style="font-family:IBM Plex Mono,monospace;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#55CDFC;margin-bottom:8px">Fast-Track · ' + TODAY + '</p>',
      '<p style="font-size:.84rem;color:#888;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:12px">Skip the queue. Pay the £500 Rising Star deposit now to lock in your date — we'll confirm within 2 hours on' + (IS_EVE?'tonight':'today') + '.</p>',
      '<a href="' + depositUrl + '" target="_blank" ',
      'style="display:inline-block;font-family:IBM Plex Mono,monospace;font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#000;background:#55CDFC;padding:10px 20px;transition:opacity .2s;font-weight:700" ',
      'onclick="gtag('event','begin_checkout',{currency:'GBP',value:500,items:[{item_id:'promoter_deposit_fast_track',item_name:'Promoter Fast-Track Deposit ' + TODAY + '',price:500}]})" ',
      'onmouseover="this.style.opacity='.85'" onmouseout="this.style.opacity='1'">',
      'Pay £500 Deposit — Lock In Now →</a>'
    ].join('');

    const urgencyEl = formSection.querySelector('.urgency');
    if (urgencyEl) urgencyEl.after(ftBlock);
  }

  /* ── Pre-fill preferred nights based on current day ── */
  if (IS_MIDWEEK) {
    ['mon','tue','wed'].forEach(function(d){
      const cb = document.querySelector('input[value="' + d + '"]');
      if (cb) cb.checked = true;
    });
  } else if (IS_WEEKEND) {
    ['fri','sat'].forEach(function(d){
      const cb = document.querySelector('input[value="' + d + '"]');
      if (cb) cb.checked = true;
    });
  }

  /* ── GA4: track which availability state user sees ── */
  gtag('event','view_item_list',{
    item_list_id:'promoter_availability',
    items:[{
      item_id: IS_MIDWEEK?'midweek_slot':'weekend_slot',
      item_name: 'Promoter Slot · ' + TODAY,
      item_category: IS_EVE?'evening':'daytime'
    }]
  });
})();
</script>


<!-- Cookie Consent Banner -->
<div id="zc-banner" role="dialog" aria-label="Cookie consent" aria-live="polite">
  <p class="zc-text">We use analytics cookies to understand how people find and use ZODIAC, so we can keep improving. <a href="./privacy" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Privacy policy</a>.</p>
  <div class="zc-btns">
    <button class="zc-decline" onclick="zcDecline()">Decline</button>
    <button class="zc-accept" onclick="zcAccept()">Accept cookies</button>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var stored=localStorage.getItem('zc_consent');
  if(stored==='granted'){
    if(typeof gtag==='function') gtag('consent','update',{analytics_storage:'granted'});
  } else if(!stored){
    setTimeout(function(){var b=document.getElementById('zc-banner');if(b)b.classList.add('show');},600);
  }
})();
window.zcAccept=function(){
  localStorage.setItem('zc_consent','granted');
  if(typeof gtag==='function') gtag('consent','update',{analytics_storage:'granted',ad_storage:'denied',ad_user_data:'denied',ad_personalization:'denied'});
  var b=document.getElementById('zc-banner');if(b){b.classList.remove('show');}
  if(typeof gtag==='function') gtag('event','cookie_consent',{consent_action:'accept'});
};
window.zcDecline=function(){
  localStorage.setItem('zc_consent','declined');
  var b=document.getElementById('zc-banner');if(b){b.classList.remove('show');}
};
</script>
</body>
</html>

					<p><strong>Date & time</strong><br>5 - 28 August 2026<br>12:00 - 17:00</p>					<p><strong>Location</strong><br>FUSEBOX<br>2 Bucklands Wharf, Thames Side, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 1TF<br><a href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/oa3kcqm9GmQQzpqo7" target="_blank" class="map-link">Getting here</a></p>					<p><strong>Recommended age</strong><br>The exhibition features a range of responses to the three themes: Magyck, Matter, and Queer. 			<div class="column eight-col no-margin-left full-col-mobile">
				<div class="six-in-eight">
					<h2>Overview</h2>
					<div class="large-copy margin-top-small">
						<p>This large-scale Open Call Exhibition features 70+ artists across three themes: Magyck, Matter, and Queer. The exhibition will unfold across three zones within FUSEBOX, reflecting its spirit as a space that matters, is magical, and is proudly queer-safe. Our aim: to reopen and reconnect FUSEBOX with the local community.</p>
					</div>
					<p>Spanning painting, drawing, sculpture, textiles, animation, dance and more, the exhibition brings together a wide range of perspectives, experiences and stories that inspire young and emerging artists today.</p>
<p>This is the first exhibition at FUSEBOX in over a year, following our closure after two devastating flooding incidents. We are delighted to reopen with an exhibition that celebrates our venue as a creative playground, a unique cultural space and a home for our community.</p>
<p>Curated by our Young Creatives, artists were invited to submit work in response to any of the three themes underpinning the exhibition: Matter, Queer, Magyck. Together, these works reflect FUSEBOX as we know it: a space that Matters, a space that is Queer, and a space filled with Magyck.</p>
<p>MATTER is everywhere: from the texture of objects to the things that bring us together. It is physical form, but also presence, impact and meaning. These works interrogate and celebrate matter in all its interpretations. We ask: what matters? Is it texture, weight and structure—or identity, belonging and significance?</p>
<p>QUEER is presented here in all its complexity. Queerness is more than identity; it is a way of seeing, being and creating. It challenges norms, celebrates difference, and reimagines the world through radical self-expression. These works honour the breadth of queer experience and affirm voices that refuse to be silenced.</p>
<p>MAGYCK means different things to different people. It can be found in the beauty of the everyday, in fantasy, illusion and the extraordinary. It is an encounter with the unknown. Whether expressed through culture, folklore, ritual, community, love or nature, these works remind us that Magyck has the power to inspire us all.</p>
<p><strong>Please note</strong><br />
The exhibition features a range of responses to the three themes: Magyck, Matter, and Queer. Some works explore personal stories that visitors may find distressing, and there is also some nudity.</p>
				</div>

<p>There are reduced hours on 13 – 14 August when the venue will be open 16:00 – 19:00.</p>

											<h3>About the show</h3>
<p>Ever wondered what your teacher was thinking? Let Facebook’s Mrs Smith enlighten you!
Mrs Smith was an ordinary teacher in an ordinary school until she went viral on Facebook and accidentally became a stand up comedian....</p>

<p>'A full, frank and very funny insight into the world of primary school education'</p>

<p>'Absolutely brilliant night, a gold star for Mrs Smith!'</p>

<p>'Being in Mrs Smith's company and listening to her tales and thoughts is like being with your naughtiest school best friend!'</p>

<p>'With a mix of laughter and nostalgia guaranteed, comparisons could easily be drawn to Peter Kay, a comedian with the rare ability to hold up a mirror to the audience, making it feel as though she has known them their entire lives' - Fringe Review Magazine, Brighton</p>

<p>This show is suitable for 18+</p>

				<div class="ticketsolve-img"><img src="https://dm7lxewn39lms.cloudfront.net/as-assets/variants/8e4zjhhs4c01k7x2hht8hryz9pmr/4bcc0e192a81979506f0bd22680c2d98afc0b125e148fd2cada612fb8c19503f" alt="Anthem for Dissatisfaction" /></div>
				<div class="six-in-eight padded-top ticketsolve-copy">
											<b>'Irish Twins' Sarah and Jamie are about to hit 30. But before they do, they're re-living their greatest hits. Pop, rock and punk rails against austerity Britain and an ever-failing Tory-government: Oasis, The Jam, Springsteen and Sam Fender songs scream at the state of the nation. A euphoric, working-class celebration of the power of live music, teenage angst, sibling rivalry and love.</b>
<p></p>
<p></p>
<h3>About the show</h3>

<p>Songs aren’t just about love or breakups. They’re about desire. Gambling. Shouting. Being skint. Frustration. Love too. They’re about us. Me and her. This is our language, our way of consistently telling each other: It’s alright mate I’ve got you! I get it!</p>

<p>The Credit Crunch, 2007. ‘Irish Twins’ Sarah and Jamie are growing up in Belfast with a shared obsession of
music and the weight of parents on the breadline. Pop, rock and punk rails against austerity Britain and an
ever-failing Tory-government, giving these siblings an epic score to navigate lives that are destined for
different paths.</p>

<p>Oasis, The Jam, Springsteen and Sam Fender songs scream at the state of the nation, tugging at the
memories of what it means to grow up on benefits in a country where poverty became a punchline. Benefits
Britain never sounded so good…</p>

<p>A defiant “rip-roaring tour de force” fuelled by the music and people who speak to your soul and punch you in
the gut. The multi-award-winning gig-theatre show Anthem For Dissatisfaction rejoices in working class
strength with wit, integrity, and disarming honesty.</p>

<h3>Reviews</h3>

<p>★★★★★ "Passionate and pulsing with the anthems of a generation, Anthem for Dissatisfaction leaves its mark" - Theatre Weekly</p>
<p>★★★★★ “… a celebration of the music that understands what it is to be broke, disregarded, and angry about it...heartbreaking, healing, and affirming.” - BingeFringe</p>
<p>★★★★★ “Explosive, Political and Necessary Theatre. Words can’t do justice to how good Anthem for Dissatisfaction is.” - The Indiependent</p>
<p>★★★★ “An electrifying reminder of the power of music in trying times.” - FestMag</p>
<p>★★★★ “Anthem for Dissatisfaction is great craic that reveals the great cracks in our splintered society.” - British Theatre Guide </p>

<p></p>

<h3>Company and show credits: </h3>

<p>Produced by SkelpieLimmer Productions and Brassneck Theatre Company</p>
<p>Written by Gina Donnelly</p>
<p>Directed by Gina Donnelly and Tony Devlin</p>
<p>Starring Simon Sweeney and Emily Lamey</p>

<p>Image credits: Laura Craig Design</p>														</div>

        <script type="text/javascript">

            function oxygen_init_pro_menu() {
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-container').each(function(){
                    
                    // dropdowns
                    var menu = jQuery(this),
                        animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation'),
                        animationDuration = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                    
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos',animation);
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos-duration',animationDuration*1000);

                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    jQuery(window).resize(function(){
                        oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    });

                    // let certain CSS rules know menu being initialized
                    // "10" timeout is extra just in case, "0" would be enough
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-init');}, 10);
                });
            }

            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_pro_menu);
            document.addEventListener('oxygen-ajax-element-loaded', oxygen_init_pro_menu, false);
            
            let proMenuMouseDown = false;

            jQuery(".oxygen-body")
            .on("mousedown", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = true;
            })

            .on("mouseup", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = false;
            })

            .on('mouseenter focusin', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                if( proMenuMouseDown ) return;
                
                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                subMenu.addClass('aos-animate oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating').removeClass('sub-menu-left');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating')}, duration*1000);

                var offset = subMenu.offset(),
                    width = subMenu.width(),
                    docWidth = jQuery(window).width();

                    if (offset.left+width > docWidth) {
                        subMenu.addClass('sub-menu-left');
                    }
            })
            
            .on('mouseleave focusout', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown .menu-item-has-children', function( e ) {
                if( jQuery(this).is(':hover') ) return;

                jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu').removeClass('aos-animate');

                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                //subMenu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out')}, duration*1000);
            })

            // open icon click
            .on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-open-icon', function() {    
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');
                // off canvas
                if (jQuery(this).hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }
                // regular
                else {
                    menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery(this).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-container').addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('body').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    jQuery('html').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    
                    oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu);
                }
                // remove animation and collapse
                jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos','');
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-toggle .sub-menu', menu).slideUp(0);
            });

            function oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu) {
                var menuItemWidth = jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-list > .menu-item", menu).width();
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-open-container > div:first-child, .oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container > div:first-child", menu).width(menuItemWidth);
            }

            function oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu) {
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-container > div:first-child", menu).width("");
            }

            // close icon click
            jQuery('body').on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-close-icon', function(e) {
                
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');

                menu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');

                if (jQuery(this).parent('.oxy-pro-menu-container').hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }

                oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu);
            });

            // dropdown toggle icon click
            jQuery('body').on(
                'touchstart click', 
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area,'+
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-open-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area', 
                function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();

                    // fix for iOS false triggering submenu clicks
                    jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'none');
                    setTimeout( function() {
                        jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'initial');
                    }, 500);

                    // workaround to stop click event from triggering after touchstart
                    if (window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched === true) {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = false;
                        return;
                    }
                    if (e.type==='touchstart') {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = true;
                    }
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(this);
                }
            );

            function oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(trigger) {

                var duration = jQuery(trigger).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                jQuery(trigger).closest('.menu-item-has-children').children('.sub-menu').slideToggle({
                    start: function () {
                        jQuery(this).css({
                            display: "flex"
                        })
                    },
                    duration: duration*1000
                });
            }
                    
            // fullscreen menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-open .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to hide the menu
                    return;

        <script type="text/javascript">

            function oxygen_init_pro_menu() {
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-container').each(function(){
                    
                    // dropdowns
                    var menu = jQuery(this),
                        animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation'),
                        animationDuration = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                    
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos',animation);
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos-duration',animationDuration*1000);

                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    jQuery(window).resize(function(){
                        oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    });

                    // let certain CSS rules know menu being initialized
                    // "10" timeout is extra just in case, "0" would be enough
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-init');}, 10);
                });
            }

            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_pro_menu);
            document.addEventListener('oxygen-ajax-element-loaded', oxygen_init_pro_menu, false);
            
            let proMenuMouseDown = false;

            jQuery(".oxygen-body")
            .on("mousedown", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = true;
            })

            .on("mouseup", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = false;
            })

            .on('mouseenter focusin', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                if( proMenuMouseDown ) return;
                
                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                subMenu.addClass('aos-animate oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating').removeClass('sub-menu-left');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating')}, duration*1000);

                var offset = subMenu.offset(),
                    width = subMenu.width(),
                    docWidth = jQuery(window).width();

                    if (offset.left+width > docWidth) {
                        subMenu.addClass('sub-menu-left');
                    }
            })
            
            .on('mouseleave focusout', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown .menu-item-has-children', function( e ) {
                if( jQuery(this).is(':hover') ) return;

                jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu').removeClass('aos-animate');

                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                //subMenu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out')}, duration*1000);
            })

            // open icon click
            .on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-open-icon', function() {    
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');
                // off canvas
                if (jQuery(this).hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }
                // regular
                else {
                    menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery(this).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-container').addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('body').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    jQuery('html').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    
                    oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu);
                }
                // remove animation and collapse
                jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos','');
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-toggle .sub-menu', menu).slideUp(0);
            });

            function oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu) {
                var menuItemWidth = jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-list > .menu-item", menu).width();
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-open-container > div:first-child, .oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container > div:first-child", menu).width(menuItemWidth);
            }

            function oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu) {
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-container > div:first-child", menu).width("");
            }

            // close icon click
            jQuery('body').on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-close-icon', function(e) {
                
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');

                menu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');

                if (jQuery(this).parent('.oxy-pro-menu-container').hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }

                oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu);
            });

            // dropdown toggle icon click
            jQuery('body').on(
                'touchstart click', 
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area,'+
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-open-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area', 
                function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();

                    // fix for iOS false triggering submenu clicks
                    jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'none');
                    setTimeout( function() {
                        jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'initial');
                    }, 500);

                    // workaround to stop click event from triggering after touchstart
                    if (window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched === true) {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = false;
                        return;
                    }
                    if (e.type==='touchstart') {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = true;
                    }
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(this);
                }
            );

            function oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(trigger) {

                var duration = jQuery(trigger).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                jQuery(trigger).closest('.menu-item-has-children').children('.sub-menu').slideToggle({
                    start: function () {
                        jQuery(this).css({
                            display: "flex"
                        })
                    },
                    duration: duration*1000
                });
            }
                    
            // fullscreen menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-open .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to hide the menu
                    return;
                }
                else if ((jQuery(this).attr("href") === "#" || jQuery(this).closest(".oxy-pro-menu-container").data("entire-parent-toggles-dropdown")) && 
                         jQuery(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                    // empty href don't lead anywhere, treat it as toggle trigger
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(event.target);
                    // keep anchor links behavior as is, and prevent regular links from page reload
                    if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")!==0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                // hide the menu and follow the anchor
                if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")===0) {
                    jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-open').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-open-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                }

            });

            // off-canvas menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to trigger it 
                    return;
                }
                else if ((jQuery(this).attr("href") === "#" || jQuery(this).closest(".oxy-pro-menu-container").data("entire-parent-toggles-dropdown")) && 
                    jQuery(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                    // empty href don't lead anywhere, treat it as toggle trigger
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(event.target);
                    // keep anchor links behavior as is, and prevent regular links from page reload
                    if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")!==0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            });

            // off canvas
            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu) {

                // only init off-canvas animation if trigger icon is visible i.e. mobile menu in action
                var offCanvasActive = jQuery(menu).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger').css('display');
                if (offCanvasActive!=='none') {
                    var animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-animation');
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.attr('data-aos', animation);}, 10);
                }
                else {
                    // remove AOS
                    menu.attr('data-aos', '');
                };
            }
            
            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu) {

                var container = menu.find(".oxy-pro-menu-container");
                
                if (!container.attr('data-aos')) {
                    // initialize animation
                    setTimeout(function() {oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container)}, 0);
                }
                else {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container);
                }
            }

            var oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = false;

            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container) {

                if (oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress) {
                    return;
                }

                container.toggleClass('aos-animate');

                if (container.hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = true;
                    
                    var animation = container.data('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-animation'),
                        timeout = container.data('aos-duration');

                    if (!animation){
                        timeout = 0;
                    }

                    setTimeout(function() {
                        container.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')
                        menu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas');
                        oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = false;
                    }, timeout);
                }
                else {
                    container.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container');
                    menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas');
                    oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu);
                }
            }
        </script>

        <script type="text/javascript">

            function oxygen_init_pro_menu() {
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-container').each(function(){
                    
                    // dropdowns
                    var menu = jQuery(this),
                        animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation'),
                        animationDuration = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                    
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos',animation);
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos-duration',animationDuration*1000);

                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    jQuery(window).resize(function(){
                        oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    });

                    // let certain CSS rules know menu being initialized
                    // "10" timeout is extra just in case, "0" would be enough
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-init');}, 10);
                });
            }

            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_pro_menu);
            document.addEventListener('oxygen-ajax-element-loaded', oxygen_init_pro_menu, false);
            
            let proMenuMouseDown = false;

            jQuery(".oxygen-body")
            .on("mousedown", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = true;
            })

            .on("mouseup", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = false;
            })

            .on('mouseenter focusin', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                if( proMenuMouseDown ) return;
                
                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                subMenu.addClass('aos-animate oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating').removeClass('sub-menu-left');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating')}, duration*1000);

                var offset = subMenu.offset(),
                    width = subMenu.width(),
                    docWidth = jQuery(window).width();

                    if (offset.left+width > docWidth) {
                        subMenu.addClass('sub-menu-left');
                    }
            })
            
            .on('mouseleave focusout', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown .menu-item-has-children', function( e ) {
                if( jQuery(this).is(':hover') ) return;

                jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu').removeClass('aos-animate');

                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                //subMenu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out')}, duration*1000);
            })

            // open icon click
            .on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-open-icon', function() {    
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');
                // off canvas
                if (jQuery(this).hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }
                // regular
                else {
                    menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery(this).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-container').addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('body').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    jQuery('html').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    
                    oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu);
                }
                // remove animation and collapse
                jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos','');
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-toggle .sub-menu', menu).slideUp(0);
            });

            function oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu) {
                var menuItemWidth = jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-list > .menu-item", menu).width();
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-open-container > div:first-child, .oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container > div:first-child", menu).width(menuItemWidth);
            }

            function oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu) {
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-container > div:first-child", menu).width("");
            }

            // close icon click
            jQuery('body').on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-close-icon', function(e) {
                
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');

                menu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');

                if (jQuery(this).parent('.oxy-pro-menu-container').hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }

                oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu);
            });

            // dropdown toggle icon click
            jQuery('body').on(
                'touchstart click', 
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area,'+
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-open-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area', 
                function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();

                    // fix for iOS false triggering submenu clicks
                    jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'none');
                    setTimeout( function() {
                        jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'initial');
                    }, 500);

                    // workaround to stop click event from triggering after touchstart
                    if (window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched === true) {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = false;
                        return;
                    }
                    if (e.type==='touchstart') {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = true;
                    }
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(this);
                }
            );

            function oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(trigger) {

                var duration = jQuery(trigger).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                jQuery(trigger).closest('.menu-item-has-children').children('.sub-menu').slideToggle({
                    start: function () {
                        jQuery(this).css({
                            display: "flex"
                        })
                    },
                    duration: duration*1000
                });
            }
                    
            // fullscreen menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-open .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to hide the menu
                    return;
                }
                else if ((jQuery(this).attr("href") === "#" || jQuery(this).closest(".oxy-pro-menu-container").data("entire-parent-toggles-dropdown")) && 
                         jQuery(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                    // empty href don't lead anywhere, treat it as toggle trigger
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(event.target);
                    // keep anchor links behavior as is, and prevent regular links from page reload
                    if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")!==0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                // hide the menu and follow the anchor
                if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")===0) {
                    jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-open').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-open-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                }

            });

            // off-canvas menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to trigger it 
                    return;
                }
                else if ((jQuery(this).attr("href") === "#" || jQuery(this).closest(".oxy-pro-menu-container").data("entire-parent-toggles-dropdown")) && 
                    jQuery(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                    // empty href don't lead anywhere, treat it as toggle trigger
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(event.target);
                    // keep anchor links behavior as is, and prevent regular links from page reload
                    if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")!==0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            });

            // off canvas
            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu) {

                // only init off-canvas animation if trigger icon is visible i.e. mobile menu in action
                var offCanvasActive = jQuery(menu).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger').css('display');
                if (offCanvasActive!=='none') {
                    var animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-animation');
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.attr('data-aos', animation);}, 10);
                }
                else {
                    // remove AOS
                    menu.attr('data-aos', '');
                };
            }
            
            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu) {

                var container = menu.find(".oxy-pro-menu-container");
                
                if (!container.attr('data-aos')) {
                    // initialize animation
                    setTimeout(function() {oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container)}, 0);
                }
                else {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container);
                }
            }

            var oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = false;

            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container) {

                if (oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress) {
                    return;
                }

                container.toggleClass('aos-animate');

                if (container.hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = true;
                    
                    var animation = container.data('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-animation'),
                        timeout = container.data('aos-duration');

                    if (!animation){
                        timeout = 0;
                    }

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Saturday 4 July 2026</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Way Out West presents: </strong><strong>The Great American Songbook!</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">As the United States celebrates Independence Day, on 4th July the Way Out West Collective will be celebrating the enduring legacy of the <strong>Great American Songbook</strong>. Led by British jazz singer Nette Robinson, Way Out West will perform their take on iconic songs from Tin Pan Alley, Broadway and Hollywood, made famous by legendary artists including Billie Holiday, Ella Fitzgerald, Nina Simone, Peggy Lee, Nancy Wilson, Abbey Lincoln, Sarah Vaughan and more!..</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">For this event, the incredible trumpeter <strong>Martin Shaw</strong> will be joining Way Out West as their special guest.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This promises to be a truly memorable evening, paying tribute to the extraordinary American songwriting of the first half of the twentieth century that helped to shape the development of jazz and continues to inspire musicians and audiences around the world.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Line-up:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Nette Robinson – voice and saxophones </strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Martin Shaw - trumpet (special guest)</strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Pete Hurt - tenor</strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Meredith White - piano</strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Larry Bartley - bass</strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Gary Willcox - drums</strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Way Out West (WoW) </strong>is a collective of musician/composer/bandleaders based in West London which celebrated its 20th anniversary last year. The membership is multi-generational and encompasses a wide range of jazz styles including bebop, swing, fusion and free/improvised.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">For more information, please go to <a href="http://www.wowjazz.org">www.wowjazz.org</a>  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Martin Shaw</strong> studied at the Royal Academy and the Guildhall School of Music. In a busy performing career, he has played in a wide variety of settings both live and on recording. He has played live with a long list of artists including Brand New Heavies, Natalie Cole, Jools Holland, Jamiroquai and more recently Jamie Cullum. On recordings he has also performed with Marc Almond, Billy Ocean and Gabrielle among many others. He is a regular in many bigger band settings including Stan Tracey, John Dankworth and Cleo Laine, Michael Garrick, The Bert Kaempfert Orchestra and the BBC Big Band. In between these performing engagements Martin manages to find time to teach at the Whitgift school in Croydon, on the Wavendon Jazz course and is Professor of Jazz trumpet at Birmingham Conservatoire and the London School of Music.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Nette Robinson</strong> is a distinctive and versatile vocalist, known for her clarity, emotional depth and storytelling. She worked closely with the eminent jazz composer and pianist Michael Garrick MBE for the last few years of his life, performing his settings of poetry and arrangements of songs by Bill Evans, Kenny Wheeler and Jaco Pastorius under the name the <em>Lyric Trio</em>. She continues to perform as the <em>Lyric Trio</em> with Meredith White on piano.  Aside from Michael Garrick’s songs, their repertoire now includes poetry settings by Tony Woods, herself and classical composers, such as John Ireland and Tchaikovsky.  Aside from this, Nette has a variety of other musical projects, including a celebration of Chet Baker, the Little Big Band, which presents her reimaginings of Ellington and Basie big band classics with a very reduced lineup and a trio performing concerts of her arrangements of Russian songs in the original language. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Pete Hurt </strong>has quietly been part of the London Jazz scene for almost four decades and has developed one of the most distinguishable sounds and style. His skills as a writer and arranger are beautiful displayed on the album A New Start (Pete Hurt Jazz Orchestra).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Jazz pianist, singer and composer <strong>Meredith White</strong> draws influence from a wide range of styles and repertoire. After gaining a scholarship to study classical piano at the Royal Academy of Music, she moved into jazz and has since performed in most of the London jazz venues, working with the likes of Cleo Laine, Norma Winstone, Shireen Francis, Sarah Moule and Dave O’Higgins. In addition to performing, Meredith has been a senior lecturer at Kingston University and an examiner/arranger for the Associated Board jazz syllabus. She continues to be involved in jazz education.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Larry Bartley</strong> is a bassist/composer who has been a staple of the London & international jazz scene since the 1990s, and has played and/or recorded in the bands of: Abdullah Ibrahim, Denys Baptiste, Steve Williamson, Courtney Pine, Bheki Mseleku, Ingrid Laugbrock, Jean Toussaint, Chris Briscoe, Basil Hodge, Adrian Reid (Jazz Warriors) Stanley Turrentine, Steve Grossman, Bennie Maupin, Harold Mabern, Chico Freeman, Donald Brown (of Art Blakey’s Jazz Messengers), David Murray, Orinn Evans, Gary Bartz, Jerry Dammers Spatial AKA Orchestra, Byron Wallen’s ‘Indigo’ and Jason Yarde’s ‘Trio Wah!’ </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Gary Willcox </strong>is an established drummer much in demand on the UK scene. He has toured with several jazz stars including Jim Mullen, Stan Sulzmann, Ian Shaw, Iain Ballamy and Polly Gibbons. He also runs his own quartet featuring the music of some of his musical heroes such as Charlie Parker and Wayne Shorter. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Web Links:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Website:   https://wowjazz.org/</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.netterobinson.com">https://www.netterobinson.com</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Way Out West prezentuje: The Great American Songbook!</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Z okazji Dnia Niepodległości Stanów Zjednoczonych, 4 lipca Way Out West Collective będzie świętować ponadczasowe dziedzictwo Wielkiego Amerykańskiego Śpiewnika.</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Pod przewodnictwem brytyjskiej piosenkarki jazzowej Nette Robinson, Way Out West wykona własną interpretację kultowych piosenek z Tin Pan Alley, Broadwayu i Hollywood, rozsławionych przez takie legendarne artystki,</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>jak Billie Holiday, Ella Fitzgerald, Nina Simone, Peggy Lee, Nancy Wilson, Abbey Lincoln, Sarah Vaughan i wiele innych!</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Na tym wydarzeniu, jako gość specjalny, Way Out West będzie gościem specjalnym, niesamowity trębacz Martin Shaw!</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Zapowiada się niezapomniany wieczór, oddający hołd niezwykłemu amerykańskiemu songwritingowi z pierwszej połowy XX wieku, który przyczynił się do rozwoju jazzu i nadal inspiruje muzyków i publiczność na całym świecie.</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Muzycy:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Nette Robinson – wokal i saksofony</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Martin Shaw – trąbka (gość specjalny)</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Pete Hurt – tenor</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Meredith White – fortepian</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Larry Bartley – kontrabas</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Gary Willcox – perkusja</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Way Out West (WoW) </strong>to kolektyw muzyków/kompozytorów/liderów zespołów z zachodniego Londynu, który w zeszłym roku obchodził 20-lecie istnienia. Członkowie są wielopokoleniowi i reprezentują szeroki wachlarz stylów jazzowych, w tym bebop, swing, fusion oraz free/improwizację.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>

        <script type="text/javascript">

            function oxygen_init_pro_menu() {
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-container').each(function(){
                    
                    // dropdowns
                    var menu = jQuery(this),
                        animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation'),
                        animationDuration = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                    
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos',animation);
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos-duration',animationDuration*1000);

                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    jQuery(window).resize(function(){
                        oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    });

                    // let certain CSS rules know menu being initialized
                    // "10" timeout is extra just in case, "0" would be enough
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-init');}, 10);
                });
            }

            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_pro_menu);
            document.addEventListener('oxygen-ajax-element-loaded', oxygen_init_pro_menu, false);
            
            let proMenuMouseDown = false;

            jQuery(".oxygen-body")
            .on("mousedown", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = true;
            })

            .on("mouseup", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = false;
            })

            .on('mouseenter focusin', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                if( proMenuMouseDown ) return;
                
                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                subMenu.addClass('aos-animate oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating').removeClass('sub-menu-left');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating')}, duration*1000);

                var offset = subMenu.offset(),
                    width = subMenu.width(),
                    docWidth = jQuery(window).width();

                    if (offset.left+width > docWidth) {
                        subMenu.addClass('sub-menu-left');
                    }
            })
            
            .on('mouseleave focusout', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown .menu-item-has-children', function( e ) {
                if( jQuery(this).is(':hover') ) return;

                jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu').removeClass('aos-animate');

                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                //subMenu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out')}, duration*1000);
            })

            // open icon click
            .on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-open-icon', function() {    
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');
                // off canvas
                if (jQuery(this).hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }
                // regular
                else {
                    menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery(this).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-container').addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('body').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    jQuery('html').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    
                    oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu);
                }
                // remove animation and collapse
                jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos','');
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-toggle .sub-menu', menu).slideUp(0);
            });

            function oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu) {
                var menuItemWidth = jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-list > .menu-item", menu).width();
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-open-container > div:first-child, .oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container > div:first-child", menu).width(menuItemWidth);
            }

            function oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu) {
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-container > div:first-child", menu).width("");
            }

            // close icon click
            jQuery('body').on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-close-icon', function(e) {
                
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');

                menu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');

                if (jQuery(this).parent('.oxy-pro-menu-container').hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }

                oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu);
            });

            // dropdown toggle icon click
            jQuery('body').on(
                'touchstart click', 
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area,'+
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-open-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area', 
                function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();

                    // fix for iOS false triggering submenu clicks
                    jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'none');
                    setTimeout( function() {
                        jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'initial');
                    }, 500);

                    // workaround to stop click event from triggering after touchstart
                    if (window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched === true) {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = false;
                        return;
                    }
                    if (e.type==='touchstart') {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = true;
                    }
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(this);
                }
            );

            function oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(trigger) {

                var duration = jQuery(trigger).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                jQuery(trigger).closest('.menu-item-has-children').children('.sub-menu').slideToggle({
                    start: function () {
                        jQuery(this).css({
                            display: "flex"
                        })
                    },
                    duration: duration*1000
                });
            }
                    
            // fullscreen menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-open .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to hide the menu
                    return;
                }
                else if ((jQuery(this).attr("href") === "#" || jQuery(this).closest(".oxy-pro-menu-container").data("entire-parent-toggles-dropdown")) && 
                         jQuery(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                    // empty href don't lead anywhere, treat it as toggle trigger
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(event.target);
                    // keep anchor links behavior as is, and prevent regular links from page reload
                    if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")!==0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                // hide the menu and follow the anchor
                if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")===0) {
                    jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-open').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-open-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                }

            });

            // off-canvas menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to trigger it 
                    return;
                }
                else if ((jQuery(this).attr("href") === "#" || jQuery(this).closest(".oxy-pro-menu-container").data("entire-parent-toggles-dropdown")) && 
                    jQuery(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                    // empty href don't lead anywhere, treat it as toggle trigger
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(event.target);
                    // keep anchor links behavior as is, and prevent regular links from page reload
                    if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")!==0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            });

            // off canvas
            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu) {

                // only init off-canvas animation if trigger icon is visible i.e. mobile menu in action
                var offCanvasActive = jQuery(menu).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger').css('display');
                if (offCanvasActive!=='none') {
                    var animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-animation');
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.attr('data-aos', animation);}, 10);
                }
                else {
                    // remove AOS
                    menu.attr('data-aos', '');
                };
            }
            
            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu) {

                var container = menu.find(".oxy-pro-menu-container");
                
                if (!container.attr('data-aos')) {
                    // initialize animation
                    setTimeout(function() {oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container)}, 0);
                }
                else {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container);
                }
            }

            var oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = false;

            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container) {

                if (oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress) {
                    return;
                }

                container.toggleClass('aos-animate');

                if (container.hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = true;
                    
                    var animation = container.data('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-animation'),
                        timeout = container.data('aos-duration');

                    if (!animation){
                        timeout = 0;
                    }

                    setTimeout(function() {
                        container.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')
                        menu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas');
                        oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = false;
                    }, timeout);
                }
                else {
                    container.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container');
                    menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas');
                    oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu);
                }
            }
        </script>
