GARETH LOCKRANE!</span></h2><div id="text_block-19-2479" class="ct-text-block" >Date: <span id="span-22-2479" class="ct-span" >3/7/2026</span></div><div id="text_block-24-2479" class="ct-text-block" >Time: <span id="span-25-2479" class="ct-span" >Bar 7 pm / music 8 pm</span></div><div id="text_block-27-2479" class="ct-text-block" >Price: <span id="span-28-2479" class="ct-span" >£15 on the door and Eventbrite</span></div><div id="text_block-76-2479" class="ct-text-block" >Table booking (11AM-8PM): <span id="span-77-2479" class="ct-span" >07583969014</span></div><a id="link_button-30-2479" class="ct-link-button" href="https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/kate-williams-quartet-feat-gareth-lockrane-tickets-1990731351060?aff=oddtdtcreator" target="_blank"  >Buy tickets</a><div id="text_block-32-2479" class="ct-text-block" ><span id="span-33-2479" class="ct-span oxy-stock-content-styles" >
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Friday 3 July 2026</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Kate Williams Quartet featuring Gareth Lockrane!</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>The band will be playing a varied program of music including some from Kate</strong><strong>’</strong><strong>s recently released album “On the Wing of a Dragonfly</strong><strong>’ </strong><strong>as well as pieces by A.C. Jobim, Bill Evans, Fats Waller and Mulgrew Miller.</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Line Up:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Kate Williams - piano</strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Gareth Lockrane - flutes</strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Jeremy Brown - double bass</strong><strong></strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>David Ingamells - drums</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Kate Williams</strong> has gained a reputation as both a distinctive writer and performer.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">She has released several CDs, each one to critical acclaim, including<strong> “</strong>Made Up and Atlas and Vulcana” (with her septet) and “Smoke and Mirrors”<em> </em>(with tenor saxophonist, the late Bobby Wellins). In 2020 she won the Parliamentary Jazz Award for album of the year for “Finding Home”<em>, </em>a collaboration between her band Four Plus Three and vocalist Georgia Mancio. Her latest CD, “On the Wing of a Dragonfly” was released in May 2026.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>…”</strong><strong> terrific latest release by Kate Williams, one of the British jazz scene</strong><strong>’</strong><strong>s most eloquent and best-kept secrets</strong><strong>” -</strong><strong>UK Jazz News, April 2026</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>…” Immensely likeable music…distinctive and wholehearted, the trio as one” -  Jazzwise (editor’s choice) **** April 2026</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Gareth Lockrane</strong> is an award-winning jazz flautist, composer and arranger who has worked with a vast range of musicians and ensembles including the late Bheki Mseleku, James Taylor Quartet, Dick Oatts, Gwilym Simcock, Christine Tobin, and the Heritage Orchestra. Gareth runs his own big band which has recorded two critically acclaimed albums to date.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Jeremy Brown</strong> is much in demand to perform and record with many UK artists, including Stacey Kent and The John Wilson Orchestra, and has also worked with visiting artists such as Art Farmer, Charles McPherson, Deborah Brown and more recently Joe Magnarell. Jeremy is currently a member of the BBC Big Band, and continues to freelance with various artists including Claire Martin, Alan Barnes and James Pearson.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>David Ingamells</strong> has established himself as one of the most versatile jazz drummers of his generation. He performs regularly at all the major jazz clubs and venues in the UK and works with several UK musicians including Harben Kay, Brandon Allen, Tom Ollendorff and Tara Minton.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://katewilliams.bandcamp.com/album/on-the-wing-of-a-dragonfly">kate williams.bandcamp.com</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="http://www.garethlockrane.com">www.garethlockrane.com</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Kwartet Kate Williams z udziałem Garetha Lockrane'a!</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Znakomity zespół zagra zróżnicowany program muzyczny, w tym utwory z niedawno wydanego albumu Kate „On the Wing of a Dragonfly”, a także utwory A.C. Jobima, Billa Evansa, Fatsa Wallera i Mulgrewa Millera!</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Muzycy:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Kate Williams – fortepian</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Gareth Lockrane – flety</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Jeremy Brown – kontrabas</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>David Ingamells – perkusja</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Kate Williams zyskała reputację zarówno jako wyjątkowa kompozytorka, jak i wykonawczyni.</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Wydała kilka płyt, z których każda spotkała się z uznaniem krytyków, w tym „Made Up and Atlas and Vulcana” (z septetem) i „Smoke and Mirrors” (z saksofonistą tenorowym, nieżyjącym już Bobbym Wellinsem). W 2020 roku zdobyła nagrodę Parliamentary Jazz Award za album roku za „Finding Home”, wspólny projekt jej zespołu Four Plus Three i wokalistki Georgii Mancio. Jej najnowsza płyta, „On the Wing of a Dragonfly”, ukazała się w maju 2026.</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>…”Wspaniałe najnowsze wydawnictwo Kate Williams, jednej z najbardziej wymownych i najlepiej strzeżonych skarbów brytyjskiej sceny jazzowej” - UK Jazz News, kwiecień 2026</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>…”Niezwykle sympatyczna muzyka…wyjątkowa i szczera, trio jako jedność” - Jazzwise (wybór redaktora) **** Kwiecień 2026</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>

        <script type="text/javascript">

            function oxygen_init_pro_menu() {
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-container').each(function(){
                    
                    // dropdowns
                    var menu = jQuery(this),
                        animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation'),
                        animationDuration = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                    
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos',animation);
                    jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos-duration',animationDuration*1000);

                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    jQuery(window).resize(function(){
                        oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu);
                    });

                    // let certain CSS rules know menu being initialized
                    // "10" timeout is extra just in case, "0" would be enough
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-init');}, 10);
                });
            }

            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_pro_menu);
            document.addEventListener('oxygen-ajax-element-loaded', oxygen_init_pro_menu, false);
            
            let proMenuMouseDown = false;

            jQuery(".oxygen-body")
            .on("mousedown", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = true;
            })

            .on("mouseup", '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                proMenuMouseDown = false;
            })

            .on('mouseenter focusin', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown:not(.oxy-pro-menu-open-container) .menu-item-has-children', function(e) {
                if( proMenuMouseDown ) return;
                
                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                subMenu.addClass('aos-animate oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating').removeClass('sub-menu-left');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating')}, duration*1000);

                var offset = subMenu.offset(),
                    width = subMenu.width(),
                    docWidth = jQuery(window).width();

                    if (offset.left+width > docWidth) {
                        subMenu.addClass('sub-menu-left');
                    }
            })
            
            .on('mouseleave focusout', '.oxy-pro-menu-show-dropdown .menu-item-has-children', function( e ) {
                if( jQuery(this).is(':hover') ) return;

                jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu').removeClass('aos-animate');

                var subMenu = jQuery(this).children('.sub-menu');
                //subMenu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out');

                var duration = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');
                setTimeout(function() {subMenu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animating-out')}, duration*1000);
            })

            // open icon click
            .on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-open-icon', function() {    
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');
                // off canvas
                if (jQuery(this).hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }
                // regular
                else {
                    menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery(this).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-container').addClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('body').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    jQuery('html').addClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                    
                    oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu);
                }
                // remove animation and collapse
                jQuery('.sub-menu', menu).attr('data-aos','');
                jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-toggle .sub-menu', menu).slideUp(0);
            });

            function oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu) {
                var menuItemWidth = jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-list > .menu-item", menu).width();
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-open-container > div:first-child, .oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container > div:first-child", menu).width(menuItemWidth);
            }

            function oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu) {
                jQuery(".oxy-pro-menu-container > div:first-child", menu).width("");
            }

            // close icon click
            jQuery('body').on('click', '.oxy-pro-menu-mobile-close-icon', function(e) {
                
                var menu = jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu');

                menu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                jQuery(this).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');

                if (jQuery(this).parent('.oxy-pro-menu-container').hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu);
                }

                oxygen_pro_menu_unset_static_width(menu);
            });

            // dropdown toggle icon click
            jQuery('body').on(
                'touchstart click', 
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area,'+
                '.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-links-toggle.oxy-pro-menu-open-container .menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area', 
                function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();

                    // fix for iOS false triggering submenu clicks
                    jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'none');
                    setTimeout( function() {
                        jQuery('.sub-menu').css('pointer-events', 'initial');
                    }, 500);

                    // workaround to stop click event from triggering after touchstart
                    if (window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched === true) {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = false;
                        return;
                    }
                    if (e.type==='touchstart') {
                        window.oxygenProMenuIconTouched = true;
                    }
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(this);
                }
            );

            function oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(trigger) {

                var duration = jQuery(trigger).parents('.oxy-pro-menu-container').data('oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-animation-duration');

                jQuery(trigger).closest('.menu-item-has-children').children('.sub-menu').slideToggle({
                    start: function () {
                        jQuery(this).css({
                            display: "flex"
                        })
                    },
                    duration: duration*1000
                });
            }
                    
            // fullscreen menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-open .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to hide the menu
                    return;
                }
                else if ((jQuery(this).attr("href") === "#" || jQuery(this).closest(".oxy-pro-menu-container").data("entire-parent-toggles-dropdown")) && 
                         jQuery(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                    // empty href don't lead anywhere, treat it as toggle trigger
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(event.target);
                    // keep anchor links behavior as is, and prevent regular links from page reload
                    if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")!==0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                // hide the menu and follow the anchor
                if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")===0) {
                    jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-open').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open');
                    jQuery('.oxy-pro-menu-open-container').removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-open-container');
                    jQuery('.oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow').removeClass('oxy-nav-menu-prevent-overflow');
                }

            });

            // off-canvas menu link click
            var selector = '.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas .menu-item a';
            jQuery('body').on('click', selector, function(event){
                if (jQuery(event.target).closest('.oxy-pro-menu-dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                    // toggle icon clicked, no need to trigger it 
                    return;
                }
                else if ((jQuery(this).attr("href") === "#" || jQuery(this).closest(".oxy-pro-menu-container").data("entire-parent-toggles-dropdown")) && 
                    jQuery(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                    // empty href don't lead anywhere, treat it as toggle trigger
                    oxygen_pro_menu_toggle_dropdown(event.target);
                    // keep anchor links behavior as is, and prevent regular links from page reload
                    if (jQuery(this).attr("href").indexOf("#")!==0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            });

            // off canvas
            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_init(menu) {

                // only init off-canvas animation if trigger icon is visible i.e. mobile menu in action
                var offCanvasActive = jQuery(menu).siblings('.oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-trigger').css('display');
                if (offCanvasActive!=='none') {
                    var animation = menu.data('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-animation');
                    setTimeout(function() {menu.attr('data-aos', animation);}, 10);
                }
                else {
                    // remove AOS
                    menu.attr('data-aos', '');
                };
            }
            
            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_run(menu) {

                var container = menu.find(".oxy-pro-menu-container");
                
                if (!container.attr('data-aos')) {
                    // initialize animation
                    setTimeout(function() {oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container)}, 0);
                }
                else {
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container);
                }
            }

            var oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = false;

            function oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle(menu, container) {

                if (oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress) {
                    return;
                }

                container.toggleClass('aos-animate');

                if (container.hasClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')) {
                    
                    oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = true;
                    
                    var animation = container.data('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-animation'),
                        timeout = container.data('aos-duration');

                    if (!animation){
                        timeout = 0;
                    }

                    setTimeout(function() {
                        container.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container')
                        menu.removeClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas');
                        oxygen_offcanvas_menu_toggle_in_progress = false;
                    }, timeout);
                }
                else {
                    container.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas-container');
                    menu.addClass('oxy-pro-menu-off-canvas');
                    oxygen_pro_menu_set_static_width(menu);
                }
            }
        </script>

Event details

Saturday 05 Sept 2026 at 11:00 – 12:30 & Sunday 06 September at 15:00

Start

Sat 5 September 2026

Finishes

06 Sept 2026

Location

Jameson Street
Hull, UK

Dont miss Quingo Starlequinn the National Drummer @Freedom Festival this September

Looking for an excuse to dance in the streets? Quingo Starlequinn, national drummer, is here to lead a feel-good dance party through the streets of Hull City Centre. But Quingo is no ordinary drummer - he's an enormous puppet, complete with a built-in DJ booth in his drums, where a local DJ will cruise around providing the House tunes to get you moving and grooving! Created in collaboration with local groups TIC, Sunflower Music, and local Learning–Disabled DJ Ash on the decks, this is a wonderfully uplifting parade piece that you can watch as it takes over the street, or let the music carry you into the fold!

Quingo Starlequinn the National Drummer was co-designed by young people from Heart n Soul’s Do Your Own Thing and Emergency Exit Arts.

Greenwich YouthFest

Event
Events
  1. Home
  2. Events
  3. Greenwich YouthFest

Event details

Sat 26 September 2026 • 12:00pm – 6:00pm

Welcome to London’s Outdoor Youth Club.

Greenwich YouthFest is a one‑day takeover made by young people, for young people.
 Music. Sports. Gaming. Street culture. Creative vibes. All in one place.

On Saturday 26 September, Woolwich turns into a full outdoor youth party! Packed with live stages, zones to explore and spaces to just hang out and be you.

Where: General Gordon Square, Woolwich Waves & Tramshed
When: Saturday 26 September
Time: 12pm–6pm
Tickets: FREE

What’s the Vibe?

Think festival meets youth club meets culture takeover.

From DJs and live performances to gaming, sports, theatre and street food, YouthFest puts young people at the centre! On stage, behind the scenes and running the show.

Pull up with your friends.
 Watch. Perform. Compete. Create. Chill.
 

Who’s It For?

  • Young people aged 11–19 in the Royal Borough of Greenwich
  • Creatives, performers, gamers, athletes, entrepreneurs
  • Anyone who wants to come and vibe, chill or try something new

This Event and all pre-event programmes are funded by the Royal Borough of Greenwich as part of Royal Greenwich Festivals

The Zones

Main Stage - General Gordon Square

12-6pm

Big performances. Big energy. Big moments.

Showcasing the incredible talent, creativity and energy of young people, expect a packed programme of live performances, showcases and special moments throughout the day.

Expect great performances, big crowd moments and plenty to keep you entertained throughout the day.

Sports Zone @ Woolwich Waves 

12-5pm

  • Sports tournaments
  • Drop‑in sports challenges

Whether you’re competing or spectating — this zone stays active.

 

Young Peoples’ Market - General Gordon Square

12-5pm

Young Entrepenuers. Real deals. Real hustle.

Pop‑up stalls from young entrepreneurs, creatives, food traders and street artists, plus youth services you actually want to know about.

Come browse and discover local businesses.

 

Theatre Zone @ Tramshed

12-5pm

Stories. Voices. Takeover.

Workshops and performances from young creatives and local theatre groups — including stand-up comedy, monologues, scratch theatre and interactive sessions.

No pressure. Lots of creativity.

Pre-event Opportunities

Your words matter!

Do you like writing? Are you interested in workshopping, receiving feedback, and having the opportunity to perform your work in a theatre setting?

Submit a piece to our creative writing open call. It can be poetry, a story, a theatre piece or song lyrics.

  • Deadline for submissions - 10am on Friday 4 September 2026.
  • Successful applicants will be invited to attend two workshops on Monday 14 and Monday 21 September from 5pm to 7pm.

  • Perform your piece at the creative writing showcase on Saturday 26 September at Tramshed in Woolwich, as part of Greenwich YouthFest.

     

 This event and all pre-event programmes are funded by the Royal Borough of Greenwich as part of Royal Greenwich Festivals.

            <script type="text/javascript">
            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_burger);
            function oxygen_init_burger($) {
                
                $('.oxy-burger-trigger').each(function( i, OxyBurgerTrigger ) {
                    
                    let touchEventOption =  $( OxyBurgerTrigger ).children('.hamburger').data('touch');
                    let touchEvent = 'ontouchstart' in window ? touchEventOption : 'click';     
                    
                    // Close hamburger when element clicked 
                    $( OxyBurgerTrigger ).on( touchEvent, function(e) {    
                        
                        e.stopPropagation();

                        // Check user wants animations
                        if ($(this).children( '.hamburger' ).data('animation') !== 'disable') {
                            $(this).children( '.hamburger' ).toggleClass('is-active');
                        }
                        
                    } );
                    
                } );
                
                
                
                // For listening for modals closing to close the hamburger
                var className = 'live';
                var target = document.querySelectorAll(".oxy-modal-backdrop[data-trigger='user_clicks_element']");
                for (var i = 0; i < target.length; i++) {

                    // create an observer instance
                    var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
                        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                            
                            // When the style changes on modal backdrop
                            if (mutation.attributeName === 'style') {

                                // If the modal is live and is closing  
                                if(!mutation.target.classList.contains(className)){

                                    // Close the toggle
                                    closeToggle(mutation.target);

                                }
                            }  
                        });
                    });

                    // configuration of the observer
                    var config = { 
                        attributes: true,
                        attributeFilter: ['style'],
                        subtree: false
                    };

                    // pass in the target node, as well as the observer options
                    observer.observe(target[i], config);
                }
                
                
               // Helper function to close hamburger if modal closed.
                function closeToggle(elem) {
                    
                    var triggerSelector = $($(elem).data('trigger-selector'));
                    
                    // Abort if burger not being used as the trigger or animations not turned on
                    if ((!triggerSelector.hasClass('oxy-burger-trigger')) || (triggerSelector.children( '.hamburger' ).data('animation') === 'disable') ) {
                        return;
                    }
                    // Close that particular burger
                    triggerSelector.children('.hamburger').removeClass('is-active');
                    
                }
                
                
            } </script>

                          }

                          
                        
                    });

                        e.stopPropagation();
                        e.preventDefault();
                            oxy_slide_menu_toggle(this);
                        }

                    );
                

                    function oxy_slide_menu_toggle(trigger) {
                                    
                            var durationData = $(trigger).closest('.oxy-slide-menu_inner').data( 'duration' );
                            var othermenus = $(trigger).closest( '.menu-item-has-children' ).siblings('.menu-item-has-children');
                                             othermenus.find( '.sub-menu' ).slideUp( durationData );
                                             othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).removeClass( 'oxy-slide-menu_open' );
                                             othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).attr('aria-expanded', function (i, attr) {
                                                    return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                                                });
                                            othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).attr('aria-pressed', function (i, attr) {
                                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                                            });

                            $(trigger).closest('.menu-item-has-children').children('.sub-menu').slideToggle( durationData );

                            $(trigger).attr('aria-expanded', function (i, attr) {
                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                            });

                            $(trigger).attr('aria-pressed', function (i, attr) {
                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                            });

                            $(trigger).toggleClass('oxy-slide-menu_open');

                        }        
                        
                
                    let selector = '.oxy-slide-menu .menu-item a[href*="#"]';
                    $(selector).on('click', function(event){
                        
                        if ($(event.target).closest('.oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                            // toggle icon clicked, no need to trigger it 
                            return;
                        }
                        else if ($(event.target).attr("href") === "#" && $(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                            // prevent browser folllowing link
                            event.preventDefault();
                            // empty href don't lead anywhere, use it as toggle icon click area
                            var hasklinkIcon = $(this).find('.oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area');
                            oxy_slide_menu_toggle(hasklinkIcon);
                            
                        }
                      });

             };

            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_burger);
            function oxygen_init_burger($) {
                
                $('.oxy-burger-trigger').each(function( i, OxyBurgerTrigger ) {
                    
                    let touchEventOption =  $( OxyBurgerTrigger ).children('.hamburger').data('touch');
                    let touchEvent = 'ontouchstart' in window ? touchEventOption : 'click';     
                    
                    // Close hamburger when element clicked 
                    $( OxyBurgerTrigger ).on( touchEvent, function(e) {    
                        
                        e.stopPropagation();

                        // Check user wants animations
                        if ($(this).children( '.hamburger' ).data('animation') !== 'disable') {
                            $(this).children( '.hamburger' ).toggleClass('is-active');
                        }
                        
                    } );
                    
                } );
                
                
                
                // For listening for modals closing to close the hamburger
                var className = 'live';
                var target = document.querySelectorAll(".oxy-modal-backdrop[data-trigger='user_clicks_element']");
                for (var i = 0; i < target.length; i++) {

                    // create an observer instance
                    var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
                        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                            
                            // When the style changes on modal backdrop
                            if (mutation.attributeName === 'style') {

                                // If the modal is live and is closing  
                                if(!mutation.target.classList.contains(className)){

                                    // Close the toggle
                                    closeToggle(mutation.target);

                                }
                            }  
                        });
                    });

                    // configuration of the observer
                    var config = { 
                        attributes: true,
                        attributeFilter: ['style'],
                        subtree: false
                    };

                    // pass in the target node, as well as the observer options
                    observer.observe(target[i], config);
                }
                
                
               // Helper function to close hamburger if modal closed.
                function closeToggle(elem) {
                    
                    var triggerSelector = $($(elem).data('trigger-selector'));
                    
                    // Abort if burger not being used as the trigger or animations not turned on
                    if ((!triggerSelector.hasClass('oxy-burger-trigger')) || (triggerSelector.children( '.hamburger' ).data('animation') === 'disable') ) {
                        return;
                    }
                    // Close that particular burger
                    triggerSelector.children('.hamburger').removeClass('is-active');
                    
                }
                
                
            } </script>

            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_slide_menu);
            function oxygen_init_slide_menu($) {
                
                // check if supports touch, otherwise it's click:
                let touchEvent = 'ontouchstart' in window ? 'click' : 'click';  
                  
                    $('.oxy-slide-menu').each(function(){
                        
                          let slide_menu = $(this);
                          let slide_start = slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'start' );
                          let slide_duration = slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'duration' );
                          let slideClickArea = '.menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area';
                          let dropdownIcon = slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'icon' );
                        
                        
                          slide_menu.find('.menu-item-has-children > a').append('<button aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-pressed=\"false\" class=\"oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area\"><svg class=\"oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon\"><use xlink:href=\"#'+ dropdownIcon +'\"></use></svg><span class=\"screen-reader-text\">Submenu</span></button>');
                         
                         // If being hidden as starting position, for use as mobile menu
                          if ( slide_start == 'hidden' ) {

                              let slide_trigger_selector = $( slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'trigger-selector' ) );

                              slide_trigger_selector.on( touchEvent, function(e) {      
                                 slide_menu.slideToggle(slide_duration);
                              } );

                             if (true == slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'collapse' ) ) {
                                slide_menu.find(".menu-item a[href^='#']:not([href='#'])").on('click', function(e) {
                                    slide_trigger_selector.click()
                                })
                            }

                          }
                        
                          if ('enable' === slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'currentopen' )) {
                              
                              let currentAncestorButton = slide_menu.find('.current-menu-ancestor').children('a').children('.oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area');
                              
                              currentAncestorButton.attr('aria-expanded', 'true');
                              currentAncestorButton.attr('aria-pressed', 'true');
                              currentAncestorButton.addClass('oxy-slide-menu_open');
                              currentAncestorButton.closest('.current-menu-ancestor').children('.sub-menu').slideDown(0);
                          }

                          
                        
                    });

                 // Sub menu icon being clicked
                 $('.oxy-slide-menu, .oxygen-builder-body').on( touchEvent, '.menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area',  function(e) {  
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        e.preventDefault();
                            oxy_slide_menu_toggle(this);
                        }

                    );
                

                    function oxy_slide_menu_toggle(trigger) {
                                    
                            var durationData = $(trigger).closest('.oxy-slide-menu_inner').data( 'duration' );
                            var othermenus = $(trigger).closest( '.menu-item-has-children' ).siblings('.menu-item-has-children');
                                             othermenus.find( '.sub-menu' ).slideUp( durationData );
                                             othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).removeClass( 'oxy-slide-menu_open' );
                                             othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).attr('aria-expanded', function (i, attr) {
                                                    return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                                                });
                                            othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).attr('aria-pressed', function (i, attr) {
                                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                                            });

                            $(trigger).closest('.menu-item-has-children').children('.sub-menu').slideToggle( durationData );

                            $(trigger).attr('aria-expanded', function (i, attr) {
                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                            });

                            $(trigger).attr('aria-pressed', function (i, attr) {
                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                            });

                            $(trigger).toggleClass('oxy-slide-menu_open');

                        }        
                        
                
                    let selector = '.oxy-slide-menu .menu-item a[href*="#"]';
                    $(selector).on('click', function(event){
                        
                        if ($(event.target).closest('.oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                            // toggle icon clicked, no need to trigger it 
                            return;
                        }
                        else if ($(event.target).attr("href") === "#" && $(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                            // prevent browser folllowing link
                            event.preventDefault();
                            // empty href don't lead anywhere, use it as toggle icon click area
                            var hasklinkIcon = $(this).find('.oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area');
                            oxy_slide_menu_toggle(hasklinkIcon);
                            
                        }
                      });

             };
            
        </script>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>DRAG BINGO AT THE BRIDGE HOUSE!!</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We’re ready to show you our balls!!<br>Bingo balls!<br>And they drop at 8!<br>(These ball gags doing anything for you?)</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Get ready for a night of Bingo, live vocals, lip syncs and PRIZES! </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">They’re back, they’re hungry and they’re naughtier than ever. The Bridge House’s legendary Drag Bingo returns for 2026. <strong>THAT GIRL </strong>(who else) takes the main hosting duties alongside alongside Penge’s very own <strong>BLA BLA GABOR </strong>who has been relegated back to shot server and ticket tearer after hitting the heady heights of co-host in January. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Each month they’re joined by a special guest host – keep an eye on socials to find out who it’s going to be!</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>PLEASE ALSO BOOK A TABLE WITH THE PUB TO ENSURE YOUR PARTY CAN ALL SIT TOGETHER!</strong> <strong>020 8778 2100</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">£7.50 per player, book online or on the night. Bring your friends!</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">*please note: this event is in the pub not the theatre!</p>

            <script type="text/javascript">
            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_burger);
            function oxygen_init_burger($) {
                
                $('.oxy-burger-trigger').each(function( i, OxyBurgerTrigger ) {
                    
                    let touchEventOption =  $( OxyBurgerTrigger ).children('.hamburger').data('touch');
                    let touchEvent = 'ontouchstart' in window ? touchEventOption : 'click';     
                    
                    // Close hamburger when element clicked 
                    $( OxyBurgerTrigger ).on( touchEvent, function(e) {    
                        
                        e.stopPropagation();

                        // Check user wants animations
                        if ($(this).children( '.hamburger' ).data('animation') !== 'disable') {
                            $(this).children( '.hamburger' ).toggleClass('is-active');
                        }
                        
                    } );
                    
                } );
                
                
                
                // For listening for modals closing to close the hamburger
                var className = 'live';
                var target = document.querySelectorAll(".oxy-modal-backdrop[data-trigger='user_clicks_element']");
                for (var i = 0; i < target.length; i++) {

                    // create an observer instance
                    var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
                        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                            
                            // When the style changes on modal backdrop
                            if (mutation.attributeName === 'style') {

                                // If the modal is live and is closing  
                                if(!mutation.target.classList.contains(className)){

                                    // Close the toggle
                                    closeToggle(mutation.target);

                                }
                            }  
                        });
                    });

                    // configuration of the observer
                    var config = { 
                        attributes: true,
                        attributeFilter: ['style'],
                        subtree: false
                    };

                    // pass in the target node, as well as the observer options
                    observer.observe(target[i], config);
                }
                
                
               // Helper function to close hamburger if modal closed.
                function closeToggle(elem) {
                    
                    var triggerSelector = $($(elem).data('trigger-selector'));
                    
                    // Abort if burger not being used as the trigger or animations not turned on
                    if ((!triggerSelector.hasClass('oxy-burger-trigger')) || (triggerSelector.children( '.hamburger' ).data('animation') === 'disable') ) {
                        return;
                    }
                    // Close that particular burger
                    triggerSelector.children('.hamburger').removeClass('is-active');
                    
                }
                
                
            } </script>

            jQuery(document).ready(oxygen_init_slide_menu);
            function oxygen_init_slide_menu($) {
                
                // check if supports touch, otherwise it's click:
                let touchEvent = 'ontouchstart' in window ? 'click' : 'click';  
                  
                    $('.oxy-slide-menu').each(function(){
                        
                          let slide_menu = $(this);
                          let slide_start = slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'start' );
                          let slide_duration = slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'duration' );
                          let slideClickArea = '.menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area';
                          let dropdownIcon = slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'icon' );
                        
                        
                          slide_menu.find('.menu-item-has-children > a').append('<button aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-pressed=\"false\" class=\"oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area\"><svg class=\"oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon\"><use xlink:href=\"#'+ dropdownIcon +'\"></use></svg><span class=\"screen-reader-text\">Submenu</span></button>');
                         
                         // If being hidden as starting position, for use as mobile menu
                          if ( slide_start == 'hidden' ) {

                              let slide_trigger_selector = $( slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'trigger-selector' ) );

                              slide_trigger_selector.on( touchEvent, function(e) {      
                                 slide_menu.slideToggle(slide_duration);
                              } );

                             if (true == slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'collapse' ) ) {
                                slide_menu.find(".menu-item a[href^='#']:not([href='#'])").on('click', function(e) {
                                    slide_trigger_selector.click()
                                })
                            }

                          }
                        
                          if ('enable' === slide_menu.children( '.oxy-slide-menu_inner' ).data( 'currentopen' )) {
                              
                              let currentAncestorButton = slide_menu.find('.current-menu-ancestor').children('a').children('.oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area');
                              
                              currentAncestorButton.attr('aria-expanded', 'true');
                              currentAncestorButton.attr('aria-pressed', 'true');
                              currentAncestorButton.addClass('oxy-slide-menu_open');
                              currentAncestorButton.closest('.current-menu-ancestor').children('.sub-menu').slideDown(0);
                          }

                          
                        
                    });

                 // Sub menu icon being clicked
                 $('.oxy-slide-menu, .oxygen-builder-body').on( touchEvent, '.menu-item-has-children > a > .oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area',  function(e) {  
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        e.preventDefault();
                            oxy_slide_menu_toggle(this);
                        }

                    );
                

                    function oxy_slide_menu_toggle(trigger) {
                                    
                            var durationData = $(trigger).closest('.oxy-slide-menu_inner').data( 'duration' );
                            var othermenus = $(trigger).closest( '.menu-item-has-children' ).siblings('.menu-item-has-children');
                                             othermenus.find( '.sub-menu' ).slideUp( durationData );
                                             othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).removeClass( 'oxy-slide-menu_open' );
                                             othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).attr('aria-expanded', function (i, attr) {
                                                    return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                                                });
                                            othermenus.find( '.oxy-slide-menu_open' ).attr('aria-pressed', function (i, attr) {
                                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                                            });

                            $(trigger).closest('.menu-item-has-children').children('.sub-menu').slideToggle( durationData );

                            $(trigger).attr('aria-expanded', function (i, attr) {
                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                            });

                            $(trigger).attr('aria-pressed', function (i, attr) {
                                return attr == 'true' ? 'false' : 'true'
                            });

                            $(trigger).toggleClass('oxy-slide-menu_open');

                        }        
                        
                
                    let selector = '.oxy-slide-menu .menu-item a[href*="#"]';
                    $(selector).on('click', function(event){
                        
                        if ($(event.target).closest('.oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area').length > 0) {
                            // toggle icon clicked, no need to trigger it 
                            return;
                        }
                        else if ($(event.target).attr("href") === "#" && $(this).parent().hasClass('menu-item-has-children')) {
                            // prevent browser folllowing link
                            event.preventDefault();
                            // empty href don't lead anywhere, use it as toggle icon click area
                            var hasklinkIcon = $(this).find('.oxy-slide-menu_dropdown-icon-click-area');
                            oxy_slide_menu_toggle(hasklinkIcon);
                            
                        }
                      });

             };
            
        </script>

</div></section><section id="section-114-1062" class=" ct-section pad-section--xs" ><div class="ct-section-inner-wrap"><div id="_tabs-115-1062" class="oxy-tabs-wrapper oxy-tabs width--full grid grid--3 grid--m-1" data-oxy-tabs-active-tab-class='tabs-6285-tab-active' data-oxy-tabs-contents-wrapper='_tabs_contents-122-1062' ><div id="_tab-116-1062" class="oxy-tab btn--xs box-shadow--l btn--secondary" ><div id="text_block-117-1062" class="ct-text-block" >show info</div></div><div id="_tab-118-1062" class="oxy-tab btn--xs box-shadow--l btn--secondary" ><div id="text_block-119-1062" class="ct-text-block" >cast & Artistic team<br></div></div><div id="_tab-120-1062" class="oxy-tab btn--xs box-shadow--l btn--secondary" ><div id="text_block-121-1062" class="ct-text-block" >venue details<br></div></div></div><div id="_tabs_contents-122-1062" class="oxy-tabs-contents-wrapper oxy-tabs-contents " ><div id="_tab_content-123-1062" class="oxy-tab-content tabs-contents-6285-tab show-info-tab  oxy-tabs-contents-content-hidden" ><div id="div_block-1112-1062" class="ct-div-block width--full" ><div id="text_block-1113-1062" class="ct-text-block width--full" ><span id="span-1114-1062" class="ct-span oxy-stock-content-styles" >
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Persephone in Penge</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">A devising workshop focused towards creating short monologues that re-contextualise mythic characters into contemporary circumstances, through dynamic movement exercises and writing prompts.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We will be playing with Chekov, Suzuki and Viewpoints training to access the largesse of our mythic body. Writing from within this expansive, embodied playing field, we seek to connect mythic themes to our personal questions and emotional truths. We’ll shape these words into distinctive ways of speaking in order to create characters who sound like the world around us, while moving like the worlds that came before.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This is a creative laboratory that invites participants to allow their bodies to think, their minds to feel, and their presence to bridge the power of both.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Bring: movement clothes, water, notebook and writing implement.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Duration: 3 hrs.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Led by Cynthia Callejas, a cultural producer and educator from Colombia with a 20-year career spanning direction and performance across several different countries. She is currently visiting the U.K. on a grant from the national Ministry of Culture and the Municipal Institute of Culture of Bucaramanga. Her work addresses social issues and existential questions through multisensory, immersive, and interactive experiences, integrating performance creation, research, and the body as a narrative axis.</p>

                $('.oxy-burger-trigger').each(function( i, OxyBurgerTrigger ) {
                    
                    let touchEventOption =  $( OxyBurgerTrigger ).children('.hamburger').data('touch');
                    let touchEvent = 'ontouchstart' in window ? touchEventOption : 'click';

			    clicked_tab = jQuery(e.target).closest('.oxy-tabs-wrapper > div');
			    index = clicked_tab.index();  
			    
			    /* which tabs-wrapper is this tab inside? */
			    tabs_wrapper = jQuery(e.target).closest('.oxy-tabs-wrapper');

			    /* what class dp we use to signify an active tob? */
			    class_for_active_tab = tabs_wrapper.attr('data-oxy-tabs-active-tab-class');
			    
			    /* make all the other tabs in this tabs-wrapper inactive */
			    jQuery(tabs_wrapper).children('.oxy-tabs-wrapper > div').removeClass(class_for_active_tab);

			    /* make the clicked tab the active tab */    
			    jQuery(tabs_wrapper).children('.oxy-tabs-wrapper > div').eq(index).addClass(class_for_active_tab);

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Join Lauren Williams for fun summer theatre workshops.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Puppetry Workshop</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Puppetry</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Lauren Williams is a professionally trained actress and experienced creative facilitator with over 15 years’ experience as a nanny, developing exceptional skills in engaging, entertaining and inspiring children of all ages. Combining performance, storytelling and hands-on creativity, she delivers fun, imaginative workshops in puppetry and puppet making for babies, children, teenagers and families. Participants create their own unique puppets before bringing them to life through play, character and storytelling. Lauren’s warm, encouraging approach helps build confidence, communication, imagination and creativity, ensuring every participant leaves with new skills, lasting memories and a puppet full of personality.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-jxraydz">17th Aug 10 – 11am. Under 5s</a></strong><br><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-ldejgod">17th</a><strong><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-ldejgod"> Aug 1 – 3pm Ages 5 – 11</a></strong><br><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-mjelpve">17th</a><strong><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-mjelpve"> Aug 3.30 – 5.30pm 11+</a></strong><br><em>click link to book</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Improvisation Workshop</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Lauren Williams is a professionally trained actress, improviser and facilitator with a passion for helping people of all ages discover the benefits of improvisation. Drawing on her background in performing arts, youth theatre and therapeutic approaches, she creates welcoming, playful workshops that build confidence, creativity and connection. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Alongside developing performance and storytelling skills, Lauren is passionate about improvisation as a tool for enhancing communication, empathy, problem-solving and psychological flexibility. Whether you’re an experienced performer or simply curious to try something new, her workshops offer a supportive space to laugh, experiment, take creative risks and discover what improvisation can bring to everyday life.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-yzenlpo">8th Aug 5pm – Adults Improv Session</a><br><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-oemkrqd">15th Aug 3pm </a></strong><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-oemkrqd">– Open age Improv Session</a><strong><br><a href="https://www.ticketsource.com/the-bridge-house-theatre/t-vxmnapn">22nd Aug 5pm – Open age Improv Session</a></strong><br><em>click link to book</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Spaces are limited, book in advance to secure your space.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Lauren is also a practitioner for Penge Youth Theatre. See more of their work on <a href="https://www.facebook.com/share/1E2VV346FT/">Facebook</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/pengeyoutheatre?igsh=MTFwYXRqaXFqNmZvcA==">Instagram</a></p>

HEAVEN
Under The Arches, Villiers Street, London, GB, WC2N 6NG

ALL(H)OURS is a South Korean K-Pop boy group under EDEN Entertainment, who debuted on January 10, 2024 with their first mini album “ALL OURS”. The seven-member group consists of Kunho, Youmin, Xayden, Minje, Masami, Hyunbin, and ON:N.

The group name ALL(H)OURS combines the meanings of “all ours” and “all hours”, representing the group’s message of giving their all at every moment and sharing their energy with their fans. Their official fandom name MIN(UT)E also follows the theme of time, symbolizing the special moments created together between ALL(H)OURS and their fans.

All ticket categories already include admission to the concert. This means that if you purchase an Early Entrance, VIP or VVIP ticket, you do not need to purchase an additional GA ticket.
